A first conviction can bring up to six months in jail, a fine, or both [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

The law is old and weakly used. In March 2025 the Supreme Court said that although the Act was more than 70 years old, "there is no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit". It ordered states to appoint enforcement officers and set up complaint systems, such as a toll-free number or email [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. Every month spent on a bottle that promises to "fix" periods is a month in which the real cause goes unexamined.

## How to be taken seriously by a doctor

You do not need a diagnosis before you ask for one. What helps:

- Keep a pain diary for two cycles: which days hurt, a score out of ten, what you could not do and what you took.
- Say it plainly: "This pain stops my normal life. I want it investigated." Then ask: "Could this be endometriosis?"
- Ask what the next step will be if the scan is normal and the pain continues.
- If you are told the pain will settle after marriage or a baby, get a second opinion from a gynaecologist.
- Teenagers can also use Adolescent Friendly Health Centres, at primary and community health centres, district hospitals and medical colleges. They are meant to be places young people can visit without hesitation [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]].
- Know that treatment exists even though there is no cure: painkillers called NSAIDs, hormonal medicines such as combined contraceptive pills, and surgery in some cases [[who-endometriosis]]. Take hormonal medicines only on a doctor's prescription.

Go to a hospital the same day if the pain comes with fainting, fever or very heavy bleeding.

The girl in Indore did not need to be braver. She needed one adult, at home or in a clinic, to treat her pain as information instead of a test of how much she could bear.
endometriosis-pain-dismissed-diagnosis-d.hg:
Socho, Indore ki 15 saal ki ek ladki jo period ke dard ki wajah se har mahine do din school miss karti hai. Mummy kehti hain, "sab ko hota hai". Mausi kehti hain, shaadi ke baad theek ho jayega. Chemist painkiller pakda deta hai. Saalon baad, jab uski shaadi ho chuki hai aur woh baby try kar rahi hai, tab woh pehli baar "endometriosis" shabd sunti hai. Yeh ladki real nahi hai. Par yeh delay real hai. WHO ke hisaab se endometriosis ka diagnosis hone mein average 4-12 years lagte hain [[who-endometriosis-factsheet-2025]]. Is poore time dard wahin tha. Kami thi toh bas kisi aise insaan ki jo uski baat pe bharosa karta.

## 'Sab ko hota hai': dard ko normal kaise bana diya jaata hai

Period ke dard ko teen jagah taal diya jaata hai. Ghar pe, kyunki family ki auraton ko bhi aksar dard hota tha aur kisi ne unka ilaaj nahi karwaya. School mein, kyunki kisi ne bataya hi nahi ki normal period kaisa hota hai. 2016 ke ek review ke hisaab se India mein sirf lagbhag aadhi, yaani 48% adolescent girls ko pehla period aane se pehle iske baare mein bataya gaya tha [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. Jis ladki ko kabhi bataya hi nahi gaya ki normal kya hai, woh kaise jaanegi ki uska dard normal nahi hai?

Aur kabhi-kabhi clinic mein bhi. WHO kehta hai ki kai countries mein public, families aur zyadatar health workers nahi jaante ki is tarah ka lamba chalne wala pelvic pain normal nahi hai [[who-endometriosis]]. Investigation se jaldi painkiller de diya jaata hai, aur "shaadi ke baad theek ho jayega" bol kar baat khatam kar di jaati hai. Shaadi kisi bimaari ka ilaaj nahi hai. Yeh advice ladki ko bas itna batati hai ki uska dard tab matter karega jab usse husband ya pregnancy pe asar padega.

## Endometriosis hai kya

Endometriosis ek chronic, yaani lamba chalne wali bimaari hai, jisme uterus ki andar wali lining jaisa tissue uterus ke bahar badhne lagta hai, zyadatar pelvis ke andar. Isse inflammation (soojan) hoti hai aur andar scar tissue ban jaata hai, aur yeh pehle period se lekar menopause tak kabhi bhi pareshaan kar sakti hai [[who-endometriosis]].

WHO ka estimate hai ki duniya bhar mein reproductive age ki 10% women ko yeh bimaari hai, lagbhag 190 million [[who-endometriosis-factsheet-2025]]. India ke paas apna koi reliable estimate nahi hai, isliye global 10% ko India pe aise apply nahi karna chahiye jaise yeh yahan measure hua ho. Aur yeh akeli common condition nahi hai jiska naam hi pata nahi chalta: WHO ka estimate hai ki PCOS wali 70% tak women ko pata hi nahi hota ki unhe yeh hai [[who-pcos-factsheet-2026]].

## Kaunse symptoms normal nahi hain

Period ke pehle ek-do din cramps hona common hai. Par yeh cheezein common nahi hain:

- itna tez dard ki school, college ya kaam miss ho jaye;
- aisa dard jo normal painkiller se bhi na ruke, ya jisse ulti ho ya behoshi aaye;
- aisa dard jo saal-dar-saal badhta jaye;
- periods ke beech ke dinon mein bhi pelvis mein dard, ya sex ke dauraan ya baad mein dard;
- period ke dinon mein potty ya peshaab karte waqt dard;
- dard ke saath bahut zyada bleeding, pet phoolna, ji machlana ya har waqt thakaan.

Inme se zyadatar cheezein WHO ki endometriosis symptoms wali list mein hain, jisme anxiety, depression aur infertility bhi shaamil hain [[who-endometriosis]].

WHO kehta hai ki endometriosis ka infertility se connection hai [[who-endometriosis]]. Infertility apne aap mein common hai: duniya bhar mein lagbhag 17.5% adults, yaani roughly har 6 mein se 1, life mein kabhi na kabhi ise face karte hain [[who-infertility-estimates-2023]]. Yeh mardon mein bhi hoti hai aur auraton mein bhi, aur endometriosis iske kai reasons mein se bas ek hai. Par kuch women ke liye fertility clinic hi woh pehli jagah hoti hai jahan saalon se ignore kiye gaye dard ko aakhirkaar ek naam milta hai.

## Diagnosis mein itne saal kyun lagte hain

Delay ka ek hissa bimaari ki wajah se hi hai. WHO batata hai ki har insaan mein symptoms bahut alag hote hain, isliye health workers ke liye ise pehchanna mushkil ho jaata hai [[who-endometriosis]]. WHO ke hisaab se dard aur bleeding ki dhyaan se li gayi history, aur ultrasound ya MRI jaise imaging tests diagnosis mein madad karte hain. Kabhi-kabhi bimaari confirm karne ke liye keyhole surgery, yaani laparoscopy, karni padti hai, par ilaaj shuru karne ke liye hamesha surgery ka wait zaroori nahi hai [[who-endometriosis]].

Phir aate hain woh shortcuts jo sirf delay bechte hain. India mein period problems wali dawaon ka ad karna illegal hai. Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 ka Section 3 kisi bhi aisi dawa ke ad pe rok lagata hai jo "the correction of menstrual disorder in women" ke liye ho, yaani auraton ki period ki gadbad theek karne ke liye [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. Pehli baar conviction pe chhe mahine tak ki jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

Law purana hai aur us pe amal kam hota hai. March 2025 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki Act 70 saal se zyada purana hai, phir bhi "there is no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit". Court ne states ko enforcement officers appoint karne aur complaint ka system banane ko kaha, jaise toll-free number ya email [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. Period "theek" karne ka daava karne wali bottle pe beeta har mahina aisa mahina hai jisme asli wajah ki jaanch nahi hui.

## Doctor tumhari baat seriously sune, iske liye kya karo

Jaanch maangne ke liye tumhe pehle se bimaari ka naam pata hona zaroori nahi hai. Yeh cheezein help karti hain:

- Do cycles tak pain diary rakho: kin dinon dard hua, das mein se kitna, kya nahi kar paayi aur kaunsi dawa li.
- Saaf bolo: "Yeh dard meri normal life rok deta hai. Main chahti hoon ki iski jaanch ho." Phir poocho: "Kahin yeh endometriosis toh nahi?"
- Poocho ki agar scan normal aaye aur dard bana rahe, toh next step kya hoga.
- Agar bola jaye ki shaadi ya baby ke baad theek ho jayega, toh kisi gynaecologist se second opinion lo.
- Teenagers Adolescent Friendly Health Centres bhi ja sakte hain, jo primary aur community health centres, district hospitals aur medical colleges mein hote hain. Inhe aisi jagah banaya gaya hai jahan young log bina jhijhak ja sakein [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]].
- Yaad rakho, ilaaj hai, bhale hi poora cure abhi nahi hai: NSAIDs naam ki painkillers, hormonal dawayein jaise combined contraceptive pills, aur kuch cases mein surgery [[who-endometriosis]]. Hormonal dawa sirf doctor ke prescription pe hi lo.

Agar dard ke saath behoshi, bukhaar ya bahut zyada bleeding ho, toh usi din hospital jao.

Indore ki us ladki ko aur bahadur banne ki zaroorat nahi thi. Use bas ek bade ki zaroorat thi, ghar mein ya clinic mein, jo uske dard ko sehne ka imtihaan nahi, balki ek zaroori information samajhta.

first-period-not-marriage-signal.en:
"Ladki badi ho gayi." In many Indian homes those words follow a girl's first period, and they change how she is treated. She is watched more and sent out less, and relatives begin to say her marriage should be "thought about". Consider a 13-year-old in Class 8, in a village in Bihar or a lane in Delhi. Nothing about her has changed this week except that her uterus has begun shedding its lining once a month. A biological event has been read as a social signal, and the reading is wrong.

## 'Ladki badi ho gayi': the myth of readiness

A first period means one thing: the hormone cycle linking the brain, the ovaries and the uterus has switched on. It usually arrives some time after the breasts begin to develop, which puts it in the middle of puberty, not at the end. Most girls keep growing after it, and the body as a whole, including the pelvis that a baby must pass through, goes on maturing after the first period.

So a body that can conceive is not a body that has finished growing. Everything that makes pregnancy safer, and motherhood a choice, comes later: a full-grown body, schooling, an income, a say in decisions.

Often the event is not even explained to the girl. A 2016 review in BMJ Open found that only about half of adolescent girls in India (48%) had been told about menstruation before their first period [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. A girl can be declared "ready" by something nobody told her was coming.

## What the surveys show

| Measure | Share | Survey |
|---|---|---|
| Women aged 20-24 married before 18 | 20.1% | NFHS-6 (2023-24) |
| Women aged 15-19 already mothers or pregnant | 6.7% | NFHS-6 (2023-24) |
| 19-year-olds who had begun childbearing | 20.0% | NFHS-5 (2019-21) |
| Married 15-19-year-olds using any contraception | 28.1% | NFHS-5 (2019-21) |

One in five young women in India was married as a child: 20.1% of women aged 20-24 in the provisional NFHS-6 fact sheets, down from 23.3% in 2019-21. The rate was 23.3% in rural areas and 11.4% in urban ones [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]].

Child marriage is falling. Early pregnancy is barely moving. In NFHS-6, 6.7% of women aged 15-19 were already mothers or pregnant, against 6.8% in NFHS-5, and the rural rate (7.9%) was more than double the urban rate (3.4%) [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. That group includes 18- and 19-year-olds, who are adults, so it measures early childbearing and not only pregnancy under 18.

NFHS-5 shows who carries it. Across all women aged 15-19, 6.8% had begun childbearing, rising to 20.0% among 19-year-olds. The share was 17.6% among girls with no schooling, and 10.0% in the poorest households against 2.2% in the richest [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Among married 15-19-year-olds, only 28.1% used any contraceptive method [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The pattern is marriage first, then a pregnancy she had little power to delay.

## Pregnancy in a body that is still growing

A pregnant teenager's body is doing two jobs at once: finishing its own growth and carrying a pregnancy. Marriage before 18 is usually how that pregnancy begins, and the girl rarely chose either.

When the pregnancy is unwanted, the danger grows. UNFPA India says unsafe abortion is the third leading cause of maternal deaths in the country, that close to eight women die every day from causes related to it, and that young women aged 15-19 face the highest risk of dying from abortion complications [[unfpa-swop-2022-india-insights]]. These are estimates, not a count of deaths.

Teenagers often have little money, information or freedom to travel on their own. For girls under 18 there is one more barrier. Any sexual act with a person under 18 is an offence under POCSO, so a doctor must report the pregnancy to the police. The Supreme Court noted in 2022 that this leaves a minor and her guardian choosing between a registered doctor and an unqualified provider. It ruled that a doctor providing an abortion to a minor need not disclose her identity in that report if she and her guardian ask [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

The harm is not only medical. UNICEF says girls who marry before 18 are more likely to face domestic violence and less likely to stay in school [[unicef-child-marriage-topic-page]].

## The law: marriage does not make it legal

This is general information, not legal advice. Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, a marriage is a child marriage if the bride is under 18 or the groom under 21 [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. An adult groom, anyone who performs the marriage and anyone who promotes or permits it can face up to two years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of Rs 1 lakh [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

A wedding does not make sex with a child lawful. In Independent Thought v. Union of India (2017), the Supreme Court struck down the marital-rape exception as it applied to wives under 18, so sex with a wife under 18 is rape [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, which replaced the IPC from 1 July 2024, keeps the line at 18 [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

The legal line is a birthday. A first period moves nothing.

## Stopping a child marriage: who to call

Call Child Helpline 1098, which runs round the clock and is integrated with the 112 emergency system [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. The girl herself can call. So can a friend, a teacher or a neighbour. Call before the wedding date, not after.

Every district is supposed to have a Child Marriage Prohibition Officer. In October 2024 the Supreme Court directed states to appoint officers with no other duties, and told magistrates to issue injunctions on their own motion, especially around the "auspicious days" known for mass weddings [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Whether every state has complied is not known.

If the marriage has already happened, it is not automatically void. The person who was a child can ask a district court to annul it, but only until two years after reaching adulthood [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. The District Legal Services Authority gives free legal aid [[nalsa]], and the Women Helpline can point her to shelter and counselling.

A first period is a reason to give a girl an explanation, a pad and several more years of school. It is not a reason to give her away.
first-period-not-marriage-signal.hg:
"Ladki badi ho gayi." Bahut se Indian gharon mein ladki ke pehle period ke baad yahi shabd bole jaate hain, aur inke saath uske saath hone wala bartaav badal jaata hai. Us par nazar zyada rakhi jaati hai, bahar kam bheja jaata hai, aur rishtedaar kehne lagte hain ki ab uski shaadi ke baare mein "sochna chahiye". Class 8 ki ek 13 saal ki ladki ko socho, Bihar ke kisi gaon mein ya Delhi ki kisi gali mein. Is hafte usme bas itna badla hai ki uska uterus ab mahine mein ek baar apni lining chhodne laga hai. Ek biological event ko social signal ki tarah padh liya gaya hai, aur yeh padhna galat hai.

## 'Ladki badi ho gayi': readiness ka myth

Pehle period ka ek hi matlab hai: brain, ovaries aur uterus ko jodne wali hormone cycle chalu ho gayi hai. Yeh aam taur par breasts ke develop hona shuru hone ke kuch samay baad aata hai, yaani puberty ke beech mein, end par nahi. Zyada tar ladkiyan iske baad bhi badhti rehti hain, aur poori body, pelvis samet, yaani haddi ka woh ghera jisse hokar bachcha bahar aata hai, pehle period ke baad bhi mature hoti rehti hai.

Isliye jo body conceive kar sakti hai, zaroori nahi ki uski growth poori ho chuki ho. Jo cheezein pregnancy ko safe banati hain aur maa banne ko ek choice banati hain, woh sab baad mein aati hain: poori badhi hui body, padhai, apni kamaai, faislon mein apni awaaz.

Aksar ladki ko yeh event samjhaya tak nahi jaata. BMJ Open ke 2016 ke ek review ne paaya ki India ki adolescent ladkiyon mein se sirf kareeb aadhi (48%) ko pehle period se pehle menstruation ke baare mein bataya gaya tha [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. Yaani ek ladki ko us cheez ke aadhar par "ready" ghoshit kiya ja sakta hai jiske aane ka use kisi ne bataya hi nahi tha.

## Surveys kya dikhate hain

| Measure | Share | Survey |
|---|---|---|
| 20-24 saal ki women jinki shaadi 18 se pehle hui | 20.1% | NFHS-6 (2023-24) |
| 15-19 saal ki women jo maa ban chuki thi ya pregnant thi | 6.7% | NFHS-6 (2023-24) |
| 19 saal ki ladkiyan jinki childbearing shuru ho chuki thi | 20.0% | NFHS-5 (2019-21) |
| 15-19 saal ki shaadi-shuda women jo koi contraception use karti thi | 28.1% | NFHS-5 (2019-21) |

India mein har paanch mein se ek young woman ki shaadi bachpan mein hui: provisional NFHS-6 fact sheets mein 20-24 saal ki 20.1% women, jo 2019-21 ke 23.3% se kam hai. Rural areas mein yeh rate 23.3% tha aur urban mein 11.4% [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]].

Child marriage ghat rahi hai. Early pregnancy mushkil se hil rahi hai. NFHS-6 mein 15-19 saal ki 6.7% women pehle se maa ban chuki thi ya pregnant thi, jabki NFHS-5 mein yeh 6.8% tha, aur rural rate (7.9%) urban rate (3.4%) ke double se bhi zyada tha [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. Is group mein 18 aur 19 saal ki women bhi hain, jo adult hain, isliye yeh early childbearing ko measure karta hai, sirf 18 se kam umar ki pregnancy ko nahi.

NFHS-5 dikhata hai ki yeh bojh kis par padta hai. 15-19 saal ki sabhi women mein 6.8% ki childbearing shuru ho chuki thi, aur 19 saal walon mein yeh 20.0% tha. Jin ladkiyon ne school nahi dekha, unme yeh share 17.6% tha, aur sabse gareeb gharon mein 10.0%, jabki sabse ameer gharon mein 2.2% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. 15-19 saal ki shaadi-shuda women mein se sirf 28.1% koi bhi contraceptive method use karti thi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Pattern yeh hai: pehle shaadi, phir ek aisi pregnancy jise taalne ki taakat uske paas bahut kam thi.

## Jo body abhi khud badh rahi hai, usme pregnancy

Pregnant teenager ki body ek saath do kaam kar rahi hoti hai: apni growth poori karna aur pregnancy ko sambhalna. Aksar 18 se pehle ki shaadi hi is pregnancy ki shuruaat hoti hai, aur ladki ne dono mein se kuch bhi khud shayad hi chuna ho.

Jab pregnancy unwanted ho, toh khatra aur badh jaata hai. UNFPA India ke mutabik unsafe abortion desh mein maternal deaths ki teesri sabse badi wajah hai, isse judi wajahon se roz kareeb aath women ki maut hoti hai, aur abortion complications se marne ka sabse zyada risk 15-19 saal ki young women ko hai [[unfpa-swop-2022-india-insights]]. Yeh estimates hain, mauton ki ginti nahi.

Teenagers ke paas aksar paisa, jaankari aur akele kahin jaane ki azaadi kam hoti hai. 18 se kam umar ki ladkiyon ke liye ek aur rukaavat hai. 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath koi bhi sexual act POCSO ke tahat offence hai, isliye doctor ko pregnancy ki report police ko deni padti hai. Supreme Court ne 2022 mein note kiya ki isse minor aur uske guardian ke saamne registered doctor aur unqualified provider ke beech chunne ki naubat aa jaati hai. Court ne faisla diya ki minor ka abortion karne wale doctor ko, agar minor aur uska guardian kahein, us report mein uski identity batane ki zaroorat nahi hai [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

Nuksaan sirf medical nahi hai. UNICEF kehta hai ki jin ladkiyon ki shaadi 18 se pehle hoti hai, unke domestic violence jhelne ke chances zyada aur school mein bane rehne ke chances kam hote hain [[unicef-child-marriage-topic-page]].

## Kanoon: shaadi se yeh legal nahi ho jaata

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi. Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 ke tahat agar dulhan 18 se kam ya dulha 21 se kam umar ka hai, toh woh shaadi child marriage hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Adult dulhe ko, shaadi karwane wale ko aur use promote ya permit karne wale kisi bhi insaan ko do saal tak ki rigorous imprisonment aur Rs 1 lakh ka fine ho sakta hai [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

Shaadi ho jaane se bachche ke saath sex legal nahi ho jaata. Independent Thought v. Union of India (2017) mein Supreme Court ne marital-rape exception ko 18 se kam umar ki patniyon ke liye khatam kar diya, yaani 18 se kam umar ki patni ke saath sex rape hai [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, jisne 1 July 2024 se IPC ki jagah li, yeh line 18 par hi rakhti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Kanoon ki line ek birthday hai. Pehla period usme kuch nahi badalta.

## Child marriage rokni ho toh kise call karein

Child Helpline 1098 par call karo, jo 24 ghante chalti hai aur 112 emergency system se judi hui hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Ladki khud call kar sakti hai. Dost, teacher ya padosi bhi kar sakte hain. Shaadi ki date se pehle call karo, baad mein nahi.

Har district mein ek Child Marriage Prohibition Officer hona chahiye. October 2024 mein Supreme Court ne states ko aise officers appoint karne ko kaha jinke paas koi aur duty na ho, aur magistrates ko kaha ki woh khud se injunctions jaari karein, khaas kar un "auspicious days" ke aas-paas jo mass weddings ke liye jaane jaate hain [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Har state ne iska paalan kiya hai ya nahi, yeh pata nahi hai.

Agar shaadi ho chuki hai, toh woh apne aap void nahi hoti. Jo insaan us waqt bachcha tha, woh district court se use annul karwane ko keh sakta hai, lekin sirf adult hone ke do saal baad tak [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. District Legal Services Authority free legal aid deti hai [[nalsa]], aur Women Helpline shelter aur counselling tak pahunchne mein madad kar sakti hai.

Pehla period ek ladki ko explanation, ek pad aur school ke kai aur saal dene ki wajah hai. Use kisi ko saunp dene ki wajah nahi.

first-time-sex-myths-body.en:
Long before most Indians have sex for the first time, they have been handed a script. She will bleed. It will hurt, and the pain proves something. Her partner, his mother or a doctor will be able to tell. And nothing can go wrong the first time. The script comes from films, hostel gossip, wedding-night jokes and porn, and almost never from a biology teacher.

Every line of it is false, and every line does damage: women doubted on the first morning of a marriage, couples who skip protection, people who push through pain because they think it is meant to hurt. This piece is for adults. The law treats sex with anyone under 18 as an offence whatever was said: Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for girls, and the POCSO Act for every child [[indiacode-bns-2023]] [[pocso-act-2012]].

## Myth: there will always be blood

The hymen is not a seal. It is a thin, stretchy rim of tissue around the opening of the vagina, and it has an opening of its own, which is how period blood leaves the body. It differs from person to person and changes with growth and ordinary activity. It may stretch without tearing, so many women do not bleed the first time.

When there is some bleeding, it can come from the hymen stretching or from small tears caused by friction when things are rushed. Blood proves nothing about the past, and its absence proves nothing either.

Imagine a 24-year-old bride in Kanpur whose in-laws look at the bedsheet the next morning. There is no stain, and by breakfast her "character" is under discussion. Her body did nothing wrong that morning. The family's biology was wrong.

## Myth: it is supposed to hurt

Pain is not a rite of passage and it is not proof of anything. Nervousness makes the muscles around the vagina tighten, and without enough time and arousal there is not enough natural lubrication. Going slower, more time before penetration, a water-based lubricant and stopping when it hurts usually help.

If penetration is painful or impossible every time, there may be a medical reason. In vaginismus the vaginal muscles tighten on their own whenever penetration is attempted. It is not the woman's fault and it can be treated [[nhs-vaginismus]]. See a gynaecologist, and do not accept "it will settle after marriage" as an answer.

Men are handed a script too: last long, know everything, never be nervous. But nervousness can make it hard to get or keep an erection, which is common and no verdict on anyone's manhood [[nhs-ed]].

## Myth: a partner or doctor can tell

Nobody can. There is no physical sign of virginity in any body. The hymen cannot show whether someone has had sex, and "tightness" depends on muscles and arousal, not on history. So-called virginity tests, including the two-finger test, are unscientific and have been condemned by the World Health Organization.

On 31 October 2022, in a case from Jharkhand, the Supreme Court said the two-finger test "has no scientific basis" and ruled that anyone conducting it in breach of its directions "shall be guilty of misconduct" [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]].

That ruling concerned the medical examination of rape survivors, but the science covers every body. If a trained doctor cannot read sexual history from a vagina, a husband or a mother-in-law cannot read it from a bedsheet.

## Myth: you cannot get pregnant the first time

Pregnancy needs one sperm to meet one egg. The body does not keep count of which time it is. Pulling out is not protection either. With typical use, about 20 in 100 women relying on withdrawal become pregnant in a year. The figure is about 13 with external condoms, about 7 with the pill, fewer than 1 with an IUD or implant, and about 85 with no method at all [[who-fp]].

Unplanned pregnancy is common in India: of an estimated 48.1 million pregnancies in 2015, nearly half were unintended and one third ended in abortion [[lancet-gh-abortion-india-2018]].

In 2019-21 only 54.4% of young women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom, against 87.3% of young men [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. In the same survey 35.1% of men aged 15-49 agreed that contraception is "women's business" and a man should not have to worry about it [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. So the person who can become pregnant is the one less likely to know where the condoms are, and more than a third of men think it is not their job.

Infections do not wait for the second time. Many sexually transmitted infections have no symptoms, and condoms greatly reduce the risk without removing it [[who-sti]]. If a condom breaks or none was used, emergency contraception works for up to 5 days after sex, and sooner is better. It does not end an existing pregnancy and it does not protect against infections [[who-ec]].

## Truth: consent, protection and talking first

The old script leaves out everything that matters. Start with consent. Section 63 of the BNS defines it as an "unequivocal voluntary agreement" to the specific act, and says that not physically resisting is not, for that reason alone, consent [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. In practice that means a clear, willing yes from both people, which either can take back midway. A wedding, a hotel booking or a two-year relationship is not a yes. The same section still exempts husbands of adult wives from the offence of rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A challenge to that exception is pending in the Supreme Court. It is a gap in the law, not a change in what consent is.

Then talk, beforehand, with your clothes on. What does each of you want, and not want? Which contraception, and who is buying it? What happens if it hurts or one of you wants to stop? Do not use alcohol to get past nervousness: a person too drunk to answer clearly cannot agree.

"Not yet" and "not at all" are complete answers. There is no age by which a first time must have happened, and no first time owes anybody blood, pain or proof.
first-time-sex-myths-body.hg:
Zyada tar Indians ke first time sex se bahut pehle hi unke haath mein ek script thama di jaati hai. Use bleeding hogi. Dard hoga, aur woh dard kuch prove karega. Uska partner, partner ki maa ya koi doctor "bata dega". Aur first time mein kuch galat ho hi nahi sakta. Yeh script filmon, hostel ki gossip, shaadi ki raat wale jokes aur porn se aati hai. Biology teacher se shayad hi kabhi aati hai.

Is script ki har line galat hai, aur har line nuksaan karti hai: shaadi ki pehli subah women par shak kiya jaata hai, couples protection skip kar dete hain, aur log dard sehte rehte hain kyunki unhe lagta hai ki dard hona hi chahiye. Yeh piece adults ke liye hai. 18 se kam age ke kisi bhi insaan ke saath sex ko law offence maanta hai, chahe kuch bhi kaha gaya ho: ladkiyon ke liye Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 63, aur har child ke liye POCSO Act [[indiacode-bns-2023]] [[pocso-act-2012]].

## Myth: blood hamesha aayega

Hymen koi seal nahi hai. Yeh vagina ki opening ke around tissue ki ek patli, stretchy rim hai, aur isme khud ek opening hoti hai. Isi raaste se period ka blood body se bahar aata hai. Hymen har insaan mein alag hota hai, aur body ke badhne aur roz ki activity ke saath badalta rehta hai. Yeh bina phate stretch ho sakta hai, isliye bahut si women ko first time par bleeding nahi hoti.

Agar thodi bleeding hoti bhi hai, toh woh hymen ke stretch hone se ho sakti hai, ya jaldbaazi mein friction se aaye chhote tears se. Blood past ke baare mein kuch prove nahi karta, aur blood ka na aana bhi kuch prove nahi karta.

Imagine karo, Kanpur ki ek 24 saal ki dulhan, jiske sasural wale agli subah bedsheet dekhte hain. Koi daag nahi hai, aur breakfast tak uske "character" par charcha shuru ho chuki hai. Us subah uski body ne kuch galat nahi kiya. Galat thi family ki biology.

## Myth: dard toh hona hi chahiye

Pain koi rasm nahi hai, aur kisi cheez ka proof bhi nahi. Nervousness se vagina ke aas-paas ki muscles tight ho jaati hain, aur jab kaafi time aur arousal na ho toh natural lubrication bhi kaafi nahi hoti. Slow jaana, penetration se pehle zyada time lena, water-based lubricant use karna aur dard hone par ruk jaana, yeh sab usually help karta hai.

Agar har baar penetration mein pain ho ya woh ho hi na paaye, toh koi medical reason ho sakta hai. Vaginismus mein jab bhi penetration ki koshish hoti hai, vagina ki muscles apne aap tight ho jaati hain. Isme woman ki koi galti nahi hai, aur iska treatment hai [[nhs-vaginismus]]. Gynaecologist ko dikhao, aur "shaadi ke baad theek ho jayega" ko jawab mat maano.

Men ko bhi ek script di jaati hai: der tak tiko, sab kuch pata ho, kabhi nervous mat ho. Par nervousness se erection aane ya bane rehne mein dikkat ho sakti hai. Yeh common hai, aur kisi ki mardaangi par koi faisla nahi hai [[nhs-ed]].

## Myth: partner ya doctor bata sakta hai

Koi nahi bata sakta. Kisi bhi body mein virginity ka koi physical sign nahi hota. Hymen yeh nahi dikha sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi, aur "tightness" muscles aur arousal par depend karti hai, history par nahi. Tathakathit virginity tests, jinmein two-finger test bhi shaamil hai, unscientific hain, aur World Health Organization ne inki ninda ki hai.

31 October 2022 ko Jharkhand ke ek case mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki two-finger test "has no scientific basis", yaani iska koi scientific aadhaar nahi hai. Court ne yeh bhi kaha ki jo bhi uske directions tod kar yeh test karega, woh "shall be guilty of misconduct", yaani misconduct ka doshi hoga [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]].

Woh ruling rape survivors ke medical examination ke baare mein thi, par uski science har body par laagu hoti hai. Agar ek trained doctor vagina dekh kar sexual history nahi padh sakta, toh pati ya saas bedsheet dekh kar bilkul nahi padh sakte.

## Myth: first time mein pregnant nahi ho sakte

Pregnancy ke liye bas ek sperm ka ek egg se milna kaafi hai. Body yeh ginti nahi rakhti ki yeh kaun si baar hai. Pull out karna bhi protection nahi hai. Typical use mein, withdrawal par depend karne wali 100 mein se lagbhag 20 women ek saal mein pregnant ho jaati hain. External condom ke saath yeh figure lagbhag 13 hai, pill ke saath lagbhag 7, IUD ya implant ke saath 1 se bhi kam, aur bina kisi method ke lagbhag 85 [[who-fp]].

India mein unplanned pregnancy common hai: 2015 ki estimated 48.1 million pregnancies mein se lagbhag aadhi unintended thi, aur ek-tihai abortion mein khatam hui [[lancet-gh-abortion-india-2018]].

2019-21 mein 15-24 saal ki sirf 54.4% young women ko pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai, jabki young men mein yeh figure 87.3% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Usi survey mein 15-49 saal ke 35.1% men is baat se agree the ki contraception "women's business" hai aur man ko iski tension nahi leni chahiye [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yaani jo pregnant ho sakti hai, usi ko kam pata hota hai ki condom kahan milega, aur ek-tihai se zyada men sochte hain ki yeh unka kaam hi nahi hai.

Infections bhi doosri baar ka wait nahi karte. Bahut se sexually transmitted infections ke koi symptoms nahi hote. Condoms risk ko bahut kam karte hain, par poori tarah khatam nahi karte [[who-sti]]. Agar condom phat jaaye ya use hi na hua ho, toh emergency contraception sex ke baad 5 din tak kaam karti hai, aur jitna jaldi lo utna better. Yeh existing pregnancy ko khatam nahi karti, aur infections se protect bhi nahi karti [[who-ec]].

## Truth: consent, protection aur pehle baat karna

Jo cheezein sach mein matter karti hain, woh purani script mein hain hi nahi. Consent se shuru karo. BNS ka Section 63 consent ko specific act ke liye "unequivocal voluntary agreement" kehta hai, aur yeh bhi kehta hai ki physically resist na karna, sirf is wajah se, consent nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Practical matlab: dono logon ki clear, apni marzi wali yes, jo koi bhi beech mein waapas le sakta hai. Shaadi, hotel booking ya do saal ka relationship, inmein se kuch bhi yes nahi hai. Yahi section aaj bhi adult wives ke husbands ko rape ke offence se exempt karta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Is exception ko Supreme Court mein challenge kiya gaya hai, aur case abhi pending hai. Yeh law ka gap hai. Isse consent ka matlab nahi badalta.

Phir baat karo, pehle se, kapde pehne hue. Dono kya chahte ho, aur kya nahi? Kaun sa contraception, aur kaun khareedega? Agar dard hua ya dono mein se koi rukna chahe, toh kya karoge? Nervousness bhagane ke liye alcohol mat lo: jo insaan itna drunk hai ki clear jawab na de sake, woh agree nahi kar sakta.

"Abhi nahi" aur "bilkul nahi", dono poore jawab hain. Aisi koi age nahi hai jis tak first time ho hi jaana chahiye, aur koi bhi first time kisi ko blood, pain ya proof ka karzdaar nahi hai.

freezing-arousal-not-consent.en:
After a sexual assault, many survivors put themselves on trial before anyone else does. Why didn't I scream? Why didn't I push him away? Why did I just lie there? Some carry a question they tell nobody: why did my body respond?

Families and police officers ask the same questions, and for a long time courts did too, treating the answers as signs of consent. They were wrong about the body, and since 2013 they have been wrong about the law. What follows is general information, not legal advice.

## Fight, flight, freeze: the body under threat

School biology teaches "fight or flight". There is a third response, and it is common in sexual assault: freeze. The part of the brain that handles danger acts faster than the part that reasons. If it judges that fighting or running will not work, because the other person is stronger, trusted or powerful, or because resisting may bring worse harm, it can shut movement down.

The body goes rigid, or limp. The voice does not come. The mind seems to watch from somewhere else in the room. Some people obey instructions, because complying looks like the quickest way to get through alive. Researchers call the extreme form, in which a person cannot move or call out, tonic immobility.

None of this is a choice. Consider a first-year student whose senior shuts the door of a hostel room. Her mind goes blank and her voice will not work. Later she asks herself why she "let it happen". She did not let anything happen. Her nervous system chose stillness before she could choose anything.

## Arousal is a reflex, not a 'yes'

The second source of shame is harder to say aloud. During an assault the body may respond physically: lubrication, an erection, sometimes ejaculation or orgasm. This is nerves and blood vessels reacting to touch, fear or extreme stress. It can happen without desire and without consent, to survivors of every gender.

A knee jerks under a doctor's hammer, and nobody calls it a decision to kick. A physical sexual response during an assault is the same kind of event.

Some abusers point to it on purpose, so that the survivor feels like a participant and stays quiet. Boys and men are often taught that an erection always means wanting, which can make this silence even harder to break. And when the person is under 18, the question does not arise in law at all: the POCSO Act defines a child as anyone below 18 and protects boys as well as girls [[pocso-act-2012]]. A child cannot consent, whatever the child's body did.

## How the law stopped demanding resistance

For decades Indian courts could read stillness as agreement. On 15 September 1978 the Supreme Court acquitted two policemen accused of raping a minor girl inside a police station in Maharashtra. The court noted that no marks of injury were found on her, called the alleged intercourse "a peaceful affair" and concluded that it was "not proved to amount to rape" [[sc-tukaram-maharashtra-1978]]. On that reasoning, the absence of a struggle could be read as agreement.

Parliament wrote the opposite into the statute only in 2013. The Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 defined consent in Section 375 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) as "an unequivocal voluntary agreement" to the specific sexual act. It added that a woman who does not physically resist shall not, for that reason alone, be regarded as consenting [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]].

The law now asks whether there was a clear, willing yes. It does not ask how hard she fought. Scratches, torn clothes and screams are not the test.

## What the law says now, and the gap for men

The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) replaced the IPC on 1 July 2024 [[air-new-criminal-laws-2024]]. Its Section 63 carries the same words: consent is an "unequivocal voluntary agreement", and not resisting is not, by itself, consent [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook for judges lists as false stereotypes the ideas that a genuine survivor cries incessantly or never speaks to the accused again, and that a woman who delays reporting is lying [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

> "There is no 'correct' or 'appropriate' way in which a survivor or victim behaves." (Supreme Court handbook, 2023)

The protection has a hole. Section 63 defines rape as an act by a man against a woman. Section 377 of the IPC, which covered forced penetrative sex against an adult man or a transgender person, has no counterpart in the BNS, and no specific offence replaced it [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Parliament's Standing Committee on Home Affairs warned of this on 10 November 2023 and recommended keeping the section; the government did not accept the recommendation [[prs-standing-committee-bns-2023]].

So an adult man who froze, or whose body responded, meets the myth twice: from people who say a man cannot be forced, and from a penal code that has no name for what was done to him.

## If this happened to you

You did not consent by freezing. You did not consent because your body reacted. Your body did what bodies do under threat, and the shame belongs to the person who used that.

See a doctor, even without injuries and even if you have not decided about the police. Every hospital, public or private, must give survivors of rape immediate free first aid or treatment [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Medicine that prevents HIV must start within 72 hours [[who-pep]], and emergency contraception works for up to 5 days, the sooner the better [[who-ec]]. Men and transgender survivors need the same medical care and should ask for it.

You do not need marks on your body to report, and you can go to any police station, wherever the offence took place [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Reporting late does not make you a liar.

If what stays with you is the freezing or the arousal, say exactly that to a counsellor. They have heard it before. Tele-MANAS (14416) is free and open round the clock [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. And if someone tells you their story, do not ask why they did not shout. Believe them.
freezing-arousal-not-consent.hg:
Sexual assault ke baad bahut se survivors sabse pehle khud ko hi katghare mein khada kar dete hain. Main chillayi kyun nahi? Maine use dhakka kyun nahi diya? Main bas padi kyun rahi? Aur kuch log ek aisa sawaal dhote hain jo woh kisi ko nahi batate: meri body ne respond kyun kiya?

Family aur police wale bhi yahi sawaal poochhte hain. Bahut lambe time tak courts bhi poochhti rahi, aur in jawabon ko consent ka sign maanti rahi. Body ke baare mein woh galat the, aur 2013 se law ke baare mein bhi galat hain. Aage jo likha hai woh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Fight, flight, freeze: threat mein body

School ki biology "fight or flight" sikhati hai. Ek teesra response bhi hota hai, aur sexual assault mein yeh common hai: freeze. Dimaag ka jo hissa khatre ko handle karta hai, woh sochne wale hisse se zyada tez kaam karta hai. Agar use lage ki ladna ya bhaagna kaam nahi karega, kyunki saamne wala zyada taqatwar hai, bharose ka hai ya uske paas power hai, ya resist karne se aur bada nuksaan ho sakta hai, toh woh body ka movement hi band kar sakta hai.

Body akad jaati hai, ya bilkul dheeli pad jaati hai. Awaaz nikalti hi nahi. Aisa lagta hai jaise mann kamre ke kisi doosre kone se sab dekh raha ho. Kuch log jo kaha jaaye woh karte jaate hain, kyunki us pal zinda nikalne ka sabse tez raasta yahi lagta hai. Iska extreme form, jisme insaan na hil paata hai na awaaz de paata hai, researchers ki language mein tonic immobility kehlata hai.

Inmein se kuch bhi choice nahi hai. Ek situation socho: first-year ki ek student, aur uska senior hostel room ka darwaza band kar deta hai. Uska dimaag blank ho jaata hai aur awaaz saath nahi deti. Baad mein woh khud se poochhti hai ki usne yeh "hone kyun diya". Usne kuch hone nahi diya. Isse pehle ki woh kuch choose kar paati, uske nervous system ne stillness choose kar li thi.

## Arousal ek reflex hai, 'yes' nahi

Sharm ki doosri wajah ke baare mein bolna aur mushkil hai. Assault ke dauraan body physically respond kar sakti hai: lubrication, erection, kabhi-kabhi ejaculation ya orgasm bhi. Yeh nerves aur blood vessels ka touch, darr ya extreme stress par reaction hai. Yeh bina desire aur bina consent ke ho sakta hai, aur har gender ke survivors ke saath ho sakta hai.

Doctor ghutne par hammer maarta hai toh pair jhatka khaata hai, aur koi ise laat maarne ka decision nahi kehta. Assault ke dauraan physical sexual response bhi isi tarah ki cheez hai.

Kuch abuse karne wale jaan-boojh kar isi reaction ki taraf ishaara karte hain, taaki survivor ko lage ki woh bhi "shaamil" tha aur woh chup rahe. Ladkon aur men ko aksar sikhaya jaata hai ki erection ka matlab hamesha chahna hota hai, isliye unke liye yeh chuppi todna aur bhi mushkil ho sakta hai. Aur jab insaan 18 se kam age ka ho, toh law mein yeh sawaal uthta hi nahi: POCSO Act ke hisaab se 18 se kam age ka har insaan child hai, aur yeh Act ladkon ko bhi utna hi protect karta hai jitna ladkiyon ko [[pocso-act-2012]]. Child consent de hi nahi sakta, uski body ne chahe jo bhi kiya ho.

## Law ne resistance maangna kaise band kiya

Kai dashak tak Indian courts stillness ko agreement padh sakti thi. 15 September 1978 ko Supreme Court ne un do policewalon ko bari kar diya jin par Maharashtra ke ek police station ke andar ek minor ladki ke rape ka aarop tha. Court ne note kiya ki ladki par chot ka koi nishaan nahi mila, kathit intercourse ko "a peaceful affair" kaha, aur nateeja nikala ki yeh "not proved to amount to rape" [[sc-tukaram-maharashtra-1978]]. Is logic se, sangharsh na hona hi agreement maana ja sakta tha.

Parliament ne iska ulta statute mein 2013 mein jaakar likha. Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 ne Indian Penal Code (IPC) ke Section 375 mein consent ko define kiya: specific sexual act ke liye "an unequivocal voluntary agreement". Saath mein yeh bhi joda ki jo woman physically resist nahi karti, use sirf is wajah se consenting nahi maana jaayega [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]].

Ab law yeh poochhta hai ki kya ek clear, apni marzi wali yes thi. Yeh nahi poochhta ki woh kitna ladi. Kharonch, phate kapde aur cheekhein test nahi hain.

## Law ab kya kehta hai, aur men ke liye gap

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ne 1 July 2024 ko IPC ki jagah le li [[air-new-criminal-laws-2024]]. Iske Section 63 mein wahi words hain: consent matlab "unequivocal voluntary agreement", aur resist na karna, sirf is wajah se, consent nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Supreme Court ki 2023 wali handbook, jo judges ke liye hai, in ideas ko false stereotypes mein ginti hai: ki asli survivor lagataar roti rehti hai, ki woh accused se dobara kabhi baat nahi karti, aur ki jo woman der se report karti hai woh jhooth bol rahi hai [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

> "There is no 'correct' or 'appropriate' way in which a survivor or victim behaves." (Supreme Court handbook, 2023)

Par is protection mein ek chhed hai. Section 63 rape ko aisa act maanta hai jo ek man ek woman ke against karta hai. IPC ka Section 377 adult man ya transgender person ke saath zabardasti kiye gaye penetrative sex ko cover karta tha. BNS mein uska koi counterpart nahi hai, aur uski jagah koi specific offence nahi aaya [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Parliament ki Standing Committee on Home Affairs ne 10 November 2023 ko isi baat ki warning di thi aur section ko rakhne ki recommendation ki thi; government ne yeh recommendation nahi maani [[prs-standing-committee-bns-2023]].

Toh jo adult man freeze ho gaya, ya jiski body ne respond kiya, woh is myth se do baar takrata hai: ek baar un logon se jo kehte hain ki man ke saath zabardasti ho hi nahi sakti, aur doosri baar us penal code se jiske paas uske saath hui cheez ka koi naam hi nahi hai.

## Agar yeh tumhare saath hua hai

Freeze ho jaane se tumne consent nahi diya. Body ke react karne se bhi tumne consent nahi diya. Tumhari body ne wahi kiya jo threat mein bodies karti hain, aur sharm us insaan ki hai jisne iska fayda uthaya.

Doctor ko dikhao, chahe chot na ho, aur chahe police ke baare mein tumne abhi kuch decide na kiya ho. Har hospital, sarkari ho ya private, rape survivors ko turant free first aid ya treatment dene ke liye bound hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. HIV rokne wali medicine 72 hours ke andar shuru honi chahiye [[who-pep]], aur emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karti hai, jitna jaldi lo utna better [[who-ec]]. Men aur transgender survivors ko bhi yahi medical care chahiye, aur unhe yeh maangni chahiye.

Report karne ke liye body par nishaan hona zaroori nahi, aur tum kisi bhi police station ja sakte ho, offence chahe kahin bhi hua ho [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Der se report karne se tum jhoothe nahi ho jaate.

Agar jo cheez tumhare saath reh gayi hai woh freeze hona ya arousal hai, toh counsellor se seedha yahi kaho. Unhone yeh pehle bhi suna hai. Tele-MANAS (14416) free hai aur chaubees ghante khula hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Aur agar koi tumhe apni kahani bataye, toh mat poochho ki woh chillaya kyun nahi. Uski baat maano.

genital-diversity-intersex-normal-range.en:
Many young Indians get their first look at another person's genitals on a phone screen, not in a textbook. School diagrams are outlines and cross-sections, families say nothing, and so pornography becomes the reference picture. It is a bad one. The anxiety it produces is then sold back to us as oils, capsules and creams. These are the questions that rarely get asked aloud, answered with anatomy.

## Where did I learn what 'normal' looks like?

Probably from porn. In July 2015 the Supreme Court refused an interim order to block pornographic websites. Chief Justice H.L. Dattu observed that the court could not stop an adult from watching pornography in the privacy of their room [[hindu-sc-adult-porn-privacy-2015]].

So for adults porn is legal to watch in private, easy to find, and often the only place they have seen genitals other than their own. The trouble is what it shows. Performers are selected for a particular look, then posed, lit and edited, and some bodies have been surgically altered. Real genitals vary as much as faces do [[who-sexual-health]]. Judging yours against porn is like judging your face against a film poster.

## Is my vulva normal?

The vulva is everything on the outside: the outer and inner labia, the clitoris, and the openings of the urethra and the vagina. Almost every feature of it varies.

Inner labia can be short or long, smooth or wrinkled, and are often longer than the outer labia or different on the two sides. They grow and usually darken during puberty, and genital skin is typically darker than the skin around it. That is what adult skin looks like. It is not dirt, and it says nothing about sexual activity. The pale, tucked-in, hairless vulva common in porn is one type among many, and often an edited one. Pubic hair ranges from sparse to dense, and removing it is a personal choice.

The vagina cleans itself. Clear or whitish discharge is how it does that, and a mild smell is normal. Wash only the outside, with water. Washing inside, scented washes and sprays upset the balance of healthy bacteria and invite irritation and infection [[who-sexual-health]].

## Is my penis normal?

Almost certainly. The normal range is wide, and the penis and testicles keep growing through puberty, often into the late teens. A penis that looks small when soft can lengthen a lot when erect, and looking down at your own gives a foreshortened view.

Size has no connection with fertility, strength or masculinity. A slight curve is common. One testicle usually hangs lower, and one is often a little bigger. The foreskin may not pull back fully until the teen years and should never be forced [[nhs-tight-foreskin]]. A penis with a foreskin and a circumcised one are both normal.

Imagine a 19-year-old in Indore who has compared himself with porn for years and decided he is 'small'. He has never seen another ordinary penis. He orders an oil advertised on a reel. It will not work: no oil, pill, pump or exercise enlarges a penis, and some of these products injure the skin.

## What are intersex variations?

Some people are born with sex characteristics, such as chromosomes, hormone patterns, internal organs or genitals, that do not fit the typical definitions of male or female. These are intersex variations. Some are noticed at birth, some only at puberty, and some never.

They are natural differences, not an illness and nobody's fault. Most intersex people are physically healthy. A few specific conditions need medical care, for instance for hormone or salt balance. That is different from surgery done only to make a child's body look typical, and such decisions should involve the person whose body it is wherever possible [[who-sexual-health]].

> Intersex variations are not a third thing outside the normal range. They are part of it.

Indian law names intersex variations. As amended in 2026, the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act includes 'a person with intersex variations' in its definition of a transgender person [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. The grouping is imperfect: being intersex is about the body, not gender identity, and an intersex person may identify as a woman, a man or neither. The same amendment deleted the right to self-perceived gender identity [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]], and the Supreme Court heard challenges to it on 17 August 2026 [[scobserver-transgender-amendment-hearing-2026]]. Whatever its flaws, the statute book says in plain words that such bodies exist.

## Do enlargement oils and 'sex power' capsules work, and when should I see a doctor?

They do not work, and advertising them has been against the law since 1954. The Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act bans advertising any drug for 'the maintenance or improvement of the capacity of human beings for sexual pleasure', which is exactly what a 'sex power' capsule or an enlargement oil promises. A first conviction carries up to six months in jail, a fine, or both [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

Yet the advertisements are on walls, trains and reels. On 26 March 2025 the Supreme Court said that although the Act was more than 70 years old, 'there is no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit', and ordered states to appoint enforcement officers within one month and set up public complaint mechanisms within two months [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. The business model is simple: make you feel defective, then sell the fix.

A short list does need a doctor: pain; a new lump; sores, warts or a rash; discharge from the penis; vaginal discharge that turns grey, green or yellow or smells strong; burning when you pass urine; a tight, painful foreskin; no signs of puberty at all by the mid-teens. Sudden severe pain in a testicle is an emergency: go to a hospital immediately.

Government Adolescent Friendly Health Centres offer counselling and check-ups for ages 10 to 19 [[nhm-afhc]]. If the worry itself has taken over your day, talk to someone you trust or call Tele-MANAS on 14416. Doctors have seen every kind of body. Yours is very unlikely to surprise one.
genital-diversity-intersex-normal-range.hg:
Bahut se young Indians kisi doosre insaan ke genitals pehli baar phone screen par dekhte hain, textbook mein nahi. School ke diagrams bas outlines aur cross-sections hote hain, families kuch bolti nahi, aur is tarah pornography hi reference picture ban jaati hai. Yeh ek kharaab reference hai. Phir isse jo anxiety paida hoti hai, wahi hume oils, capsules aur creams ki shakal mein wapas bechi jaati hai. Yeh woh sawaal hain jo shayad hi kabhi zor se poochhe jaate hain, aur yahan unke jawaab anatomy se diye gaye hain.

## Maine kahan se seekha ki 'normal' kaisa dikhta hai?

Shayad porn se. July 2015 mein Supreme Court ne pornographic websites block karne ka interim order dene se mana kar diya. Chief Justice H.L. Dattu ne kaha ki court kisi adult ko apne kamre ki privacy mein pornography dekhne se nahi rok sakta [[hindu-sc-adult-porn-privacy-2015]].

Toh adults ke liye private mein porn dekhna legal hai, yeh aasani se mil jaata hai, aur aksar yahi woh akeli jagah hoti hai jahan unhone apne alawa kisi aur ke genitals dekhe hain. Problem yeh hai ki porn dikhata kya hai. Performers ek khaas look ke liye chune jaate hain, phir unhe pose karaya jaata hai, lighting aur editing hoti hai, aur kuch bodies surgery se badli hui hoti hain. Asli genitals utne hi alag-alag hote hain jitne chehre [[who-sexual-health]]. Apne genitals ko porn se compare karna waisa hi hai jaise apne chehre ko film poster se compare karna.

## Kya mera vulva normal hai?

Vulva matlab bahar ka poora hissa: outer aur inner labia, clitoris, aur urethra aur vagina ke openings. Iska lagbhag har feature alag-alag hota hai.

Inner labia chhote ya lambe, smooth ya wrinkled ho sakte hain, aur aksar outer labia se lambe ya dono taraf alag hote hain. Puberty mein yeh badhte hain aur aam taur par dark ho jaate hain, aur genital skin aas-paas ki skin se zyada dark hi hoti hai. Adult skin aisi hi dikhti hai. Yeh gandagi nahi hai, aur isse sexual activity ke baare mein kuch pata nahi chalta. Porn mein jo pale, andar tucked, hairless vulva common hai, woh bahut saare types mein se bas ek type hai, aur aksar edited hota hai. Pubic hair kisi ke kam hote hain, kisi ke ghane, aur unhe hatana ya nahi hatana personal choice hai.

Vagina khud ko saaf karta hai. Clear ya safed sa discharge isi ka tareeka hai, aur halki si smell normal hai. Sirf bahar ka hissa dho, paani se. Andar dhona, scented washes aur sprays healthy bacteria ka balance bigaad dete hain aur irritation aur infection ko bulaate hain [[who-sexual-health]].

## Kya mera penis normal hai?

Lagbhag pakka haan. Normal range bahut wide hai, aur penis aur testicles poori puberty mein badhte rehte hain, aksar late teens tak. Jo penis soft hone par chhota dikhta hai, woh erect hone par kaafi lamba ho sakta hai, aur apne penis ko upar se neeche dekhne par woh asli se chhota hi dikhta hai.

Size ka fertility, taakat ya mardaangi se koi connection nahi hai. Halka sa curve common hai. Aam taur par ek testicle thoda neeche latakta hai, aur ek aksar thoda bada hota hai. Foreskin ho sakta hai teenage tak poori tarah peeche na jaaye, aur use kabhi zabardasti peeche nahi karna chahiye [[nhs-tight-foreskin]]. Foreskin wala penis aur circumcised penis, dono normal hain.

Indore ke ek 19 saal ke ladke ko imagine karo jo saalon se khud ko porn se compare karta aaya hai aur tay kar chuka hai ki woh 'chhota' hai. Usne kabhi koi doosra ordinary penis dekha hi nahi. Woh ek reel par advertise hua oil order kar deta hai. Woh kaam nahi karega: koi oil, pill, pump ya exercise penis ko bada nahi karti, aur inme se kuch products skin ko nuksaan pahunchate hain.

## Intersex variations kya hote hain?

Kuch log aise sex characteristics ke saath paida hote hain, jaise chromosomes, hormone patterns, internal organs ya genitals, jo male ya female ki typical definitions mein fit nahi hote. Inhe intersex variations kehte hain. Kuch birth par pata chal jaate hain, kuch sirf puberty mein, aur kuch kabhi nahi.

Yeh natural differences hain, koi bimaari nahi, aur kisi ki galti nahi. Zyada tar intersex log physically healthy hote hain. Kuch specific conditions mein medical care chahiye hoti hai, jaise hormone ya salt balance ke liye. Yeh us surgery se alag baat hai jo sirf isliye ki jaati hai ki bachche ki body typical dikhe, aur aise decisions mein, jahan tak possible ho, us insaan ko shaamil hona chahiye jiski yeh body hai [[who-sexual-health]].

> Intersex variations normal range ke bahar ki koi teesri cheez nahi hain. Woh usi range ka hissa hain.

Indian law intersex variations ka naam leta hai. 2026 ke amendment ke baad, Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act transgender person ki definition mein 'a person with intersex variations' ko shaamil karta hai [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Yeh grouping perfect nahi hai: intersex hona body ke baare mein hai, gender identity ke baare mein nahi, aur ek intersex insaan khud ko aurat maan sakta hai, mard maan sakta hai, ya dono mein se koi nahi. Isi amendment ne self-perceived gender identity ka right delete kar diya [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]], aur Supreme Court ne 17 August 2026 ko iske khilaaf challenges sune [[scobserver-transgender-amendment-hearing-2026]]. Apni kamiyon ke bawajood, kanoon ki kitaab saaf shabdon mein kehti hai ki aisi bodies exist karti hain.

## Kya enlargement oils aur 'sex power' capsules kaam karte hain, aur doctor ke paas kab jaana chahiye?

Yeh kaam nahi karte, aur inka ad dena 1954 se law ke khilaaf hai. Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act kisi bhi aisi drug ka ad ban karta hai jo 'the maintenance or improvement of the capacity of human beings for sexual pleasure' ke liye ho, aur 'sex power' capsule ya enlargement oil theek yahi promise karta hai. Pehli conviction par chhe mahine tak ki jail, fine, ya dono ho sakte hain [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

Phir bhi yeh ads deewaron par, trains mein aur reels mein hain. 26 March 2025 ko Supreme Court ne kaha ki Act 70 saal se zyada purana hone ke bawajood 'there is no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit', aur states ko order diya ki ek mahine ke andar enforcement officers appoint karein aur do mahine ke andar public complaint mechanisms banayein [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. Business model simple hai: pehle tumhe defective feel karao, phir uska fix becho.

Ek chhoti si list ke liye sach mein doctor chahiye: dard; naya lump; sores, warts ya rash; penis se discharge; vaginal discharge jo grey, green ya yellow ho jaaye ya jisme tez smell ho; peshaab karte waqt jalan; tight, dard wali foreskin; mid-teens tak puberty ka koi bhi sign na dikhna. Testicle mein achanak tez dard emergency hai: turant hospital jao.

Government ke Adolescent Friendly Health Centres 10 se 19 saal walon ko counselling aur check-ups dete hain [[nhm-afhc]]. Agar chinta ne hi tumhara din le liya hai, toh kisi bharose wale insaan se baat karo ya Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo. Doctors har tarah ki body dekh chuke hain. Tumhari body unhe hairaan kare, iske chances bahut kam hain.

india-blind-spots-womens-bodies-data.en:
Ask the Indian state how many young women in Bihar used hygienic protection during their periods in 2019-21 and it can answer to one decimal place: 59.2%, against 99.1% in Puducherry [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Ask how many Indian women have endometriosis and there is no reliable national answer. The World Health Organization (WHO) estimates that the disease affects 10% of women of reproductive age worldwide, about 190 million women [[who-endometriosis-factsheet-2025]]. We looked for an Indian estimate while building this magazine's facts bank and could not confirm one.

Governments plan and spend around what they can count. A condition without a number has no target and no budget line.

## Why counting bodies matters

Take one figure India does collect. In 2019-21 the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) asked women aged 15-49 whether they had ever been screened for cervical cancer. Only 1.2% had [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The number is damning, and that is its value: it is on the record, so anyone can ask what is being done about it.

Now take what is not collected. Imagine a 29-year-old schoolteacher in Nagpur who has had period pain that keeps her in bed two days a month since she was 14. Her family told her it was normal. She is too old for the period-protection figures and has never been diagnosed with anything, so she appears in no national table. Nobody knows how many women are like her.

| Condition | What India has | What is missing |
|---|---|---|
| Endometriosis | No reliable national estimate | How many women, how long they wait |
| PCOS | One national study (2024), ages 18-40 | A repeat, other ages, one agreed figure |
| Periods | Protection figures for ages 15-24 | Women above 24; pain and bleeding |

## Endometriosis: no Indian number

Endometriosis is a disease in which tissue similar to the lining of the uterus grows outside it, causing pain and sometimes difficulty in getting pregnant. WHO's 10% is a global estimate. Multiplying it by India's population would give a figure that looks like data and is not.

WHO also says that diagnosis takes between 4 and 12 years on average [[who-endometriosis-factsheet-2025]]. That delay explains part of the blind spot. A surveyor at the door cannot detect endometriosis with a question, and a woman who has not been diagnosed cannot report a diagnosis.

Hard to count is not impossible to count. But without hospital records of who is diagnosed, and after how many years, nobody can say whether an Indian woman waits 4 years, 12 or longer.

## PCOS: one study, three answers

Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is better served, because it has a study. An ICMR-funded national study of women aged 18-40, published in 2024, found PCOS in 7.2% of them by the strict NIH criteria, 13.6% by the AE-PCOS criteria and 19.6% by the broader Rotterdam criteria [[jama-netw-open-pcos-india-2024]]. The same women, examined once, gave three results under three rulebooks.

For a health planner the choice of rulebook decides whether PCOS affects fewer than one woman in ten or as many as one in five. The study sampled 8 states and stopped at age 40, so teenagers under 18 and women over 40 are outside it. And one study is a snapshot: unless it is repeated, India cannot tell whether PCOS is rising or falling. Clinic records will not fill the gap, because WHO estimates that up to 70% of women with PCOS worldwide do not know they have it [[who-pcos-factsheet-2026]].

The study also shows how much a count can reveal. Among the women with PCOS, 91.9% had abnormal blood lipids and 43.2% had obesity [[jama-netw-open-pcos-india-2024]]. Families file PCOS under "period problems". The data shows it is also a matter of long-term metabolic health.

## Periods: counted only for women aged 15-24

Menstruation is the best measured of the three, and it shows what a number can do. In 2015-16, 57.6% of women aged 15-24 used a hygienic method of period protection [[nfhs4-india-2016]]. By 2019-21 the figure was 77.6% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The same survey shows who is left behind: 95.1% of young women in the richest households used hygienic protection, against 53.6% in the poorest [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Look at the age band. Every one of these figures is for women aged 15-24. Women go on menstruating for decades after that. What a 35-year-old farm worker or a 45-year-old domestic worker uses is not reported.

The table is also about products. Sanitary napkins, locally prepared napkins, tampons and menstrual cups count as hygienic; cloth does not. Pain, heavy bleeding and days of school or work lost are not in it.

> India measures the pad. It does not measure the pain, and it stops measuring the pad when a woman turns 25.

Policy has the same shape as the data. In December 2024 the Union government told the Supreme Court that it had framed a national menstrual hygiene policy for school-going girls [[livelaw-sc-menstrual-reserved-2024]]. On 30 January 2026 the court held that menstrual health is part of the right to life under Article 21 and gave its directions to schools: working toilets with water, free sanitary napkins, safe disposal [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]]. These are real gains for girls. But women outside the survey's age band are also outside the classroom.

## What India should start counting

None of this needs new science, only three decisions.

First, report period protection for every woman who menstruates, not only those aged 15-24, and add questions on pain, heavy bleeding and days lost. Second, repeat the PCOS study at fixed intervals, widen its age range and publish the results under all three criteria. Third, have hospitals record every endometriosis diagnosis, with the woman's age and the years she waited, so that India has its own number and stops borrowing a global one.

Until then, keep your own data. Write down dates, pain, bleeding and missed days for three months and take the record to a doctor. Common is not the same as normal, and a written record is harder to wave away than one sentence in a hurried consultation.
india-blind-spots-womens-bodies-data.hg:
Indian state se poochho ki 2019-21 mein Bihar ki kitni young women periods ke dauraan hygienic protection use karti thi, toh jawab ek decimal tak milta hai: 59.2%, jabki Puducherry mein 99.1% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Ab poochho ki India mein kitni women ko endometriosis hai, toh koi reliable national jawab nahi hai. World Health Organization (WHO) ka estimate hai ki yeh bimari duniya bhar mein reproductive age ki 10% women ko hoti hai, yaani lagbhag 190 million women [[who-endometriosis-factsheet-2025]]. Is magazine ka facts bank banate waqt humne India ka estimate dhoondha, aur ek bhi confirm nahi kar paaye.

Governments apni planning aur kharcha usi ke around karti hain jo woh gin sakti hain. Jis condition ka number hi nahi, uska na koi target hota hai, na budget mein koi line.

## Bodies ko ginna kyun zaroori hai

Ek figure lo jo India collect karta hai. 2019-21 mein National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) ne 15-49 saal ki women se poocha ki kya unki kabhi cervical cancer screening hui hai. Sirf 1.2% ki hui thi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yeh number sharmnaak hai, aur yahi iski value hai: yeh record par hai, toh koi bhi pooch sakta hai ki is par kya kiya ja raha hai.

Ab woh dekho jo collect hi nahi hota. Imagine karo, Nagpur ki ek 29 saal ki schoolteacher, jise 14 saal ki age se aisa period pain hota hai ki mahine mein do din bistar se uth nahi paati. Ghar walon ne kaha, yeh toh normal hai. Period protection ke figures ke liye uski age zyada hai, aur use kabhi koi diagnosis mila nahi, isliye woh kisi national table mein nahi hai. Uske jaisi kitni women hain, kisi ko nahi pata.

| Condition | India ke paas kya hai | Kya missing hai |
|---|---|---|
| Endometriosis | Koi reliable national estimate nahi | Kitni women, kitne saal ka wait |
| PCOS | Ek national study (2024), age 18-40 | Repeat study, baaki ages, ek agreed figure |
| Periods | Age 15-24 ke protection figures | 24 se upar ki women; pain aur bleeding |

## Endometriosis: India ka koi number nahi

Endometriosis ek bimari hai jisme uterus ki lining jaisa tissue uterus ke bahar ugne lagta hai. Isse pain hota hai, aur kabhi-kabhi pregnant hone mein dikkat aati hai. WHO ka 10% ek global estimate hai. Use India ki population se multiply kar doge toh ek aisa figure milega jo data jaisa dikhta hai, par data hai nahi.

WHO yeh bhi kehta hai ki diagnosis mein average 4 se 12 saal lagte hain [[who-endometriosis-factsheet-2025]]. Blind spot ki ek wajah yahi delay hai. Darwaze par aaya surveyor ek sawaal pooch kar endometriosis detect nahi kar sakta, aur jis woman ko diagnosis mila hi nahi, woh diagnosis report bhi nahi kar sakti.

Par ginna mushkil hai, iska matlab yeh nahi ki ginna impossible hai. Jab tak hospitals yeh record nahi rakhte ki kise diagnosis mila aur kitne saal baad, tab tak koi nahi bata sakta ki ek Indian woman 4 saal wait karti hai, 12 saal, ya usse bhi zyada.

## PCOS: ek study, teen answers

Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) ki haalat thodi better hai, kyunki iske paas ek study hai. ICMR-funded ek national study ne 18-40 saal ki women ko dekha. Yeh 2024 mein publish hui, aur isme strict NIH criteria se 7.2% women mein PCOS mila, AE-PCOS criteria se 13.6% mein, aur broad Rotterdam criteria se 19.6% mein [[jama-netw-open-pcos-india-2024]]. Wahi women, ek hi baar ki jaanch, aur teen rulebooks se teen alag results.

Health planner ke liye rulebook ka choice yeh decide karta hai ki PCOS das mein se ek se bhi kam women ko hai, ya paanch mein se ek ko. Study ne 8 states se sample liya aur 40 saal par ruk gayi, toh 18 se kam age ki teenagers aur 40 se upar ki women isme hain hi nahi. Aur ek study sirf ek snapshot hoti hai: jab tak yeh repeat nahi hoti, India ko pata nahi chalega ki PCOS badh raha hai ya ghat raha hai. Clinic records bhi yeh gap nahi bhar sakte, kyunki WHO ka estimate hai ki duniya bhar mein PCOS wali 70% tak women ko pata hi nahi hota ki unhe yeh hai [[who-pcos-factsheet-2026]].

Yahi study yeh bhi dikhati hai ki ginne se kitna kuch saamne aata hai. Jin women mein PCOS mila, unmein se 91.9% ke blood lipids abnormal the aur 43.2% ko obesity thi [[jama-netw-open-pcos-india-2024]]. Families PCOS ko "period ki problem" wali file mein daal deti hain. Data dikhata hai ki yeh long-term metabolic health ka bhi maamla hai.

## Periods: ginti sirf 15-24 saal ki women ki

Teeno mein menstruation sabse achhe se measure hota hai, aur isse dikhta hai ki ek number kya kar sakta hai. 2015-16 mein 15-24 saal ki 57.6% women period protection ka hygienic method use karti thi [[nfhs4-india-2016]]. 2019-21 tak yeh figure 77.6% ho gaya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Wahi survey yeh bhi dikhata hai ki peeche kaun chhoot gaya: sabse ameer households ki 95.1% young women hygienic protection use karti thi, jabki sabse gareeb households mein sirf 53.6% [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Ab age band dekho. Yeh saare figures sirf 15-24 saal ki women ke hain. Women uske baad bhi kai dashak tak menstruate karti hain. 35 saal ki khet mazdoor ya 45 saal ki domestic worker kya use karti hai, yeh kahin report nahi hota.

Yeh table bhi sirf products ke baare mein hai. Sanitary napkins, locally bane napkins, tampons aur menstrual cups hygienic maane jaate hain, cloth nahi. Pain, heavy bleeding, aur school ya kaam ke jo din gaye, woh isme hain hi nahi.

> India pad ko measure karta hai. Pain ko measure nahi karta, aur jaise hi woman 25 ki hoti hai, pad ko measure karna bhi band kar deta hai.

Policy ka shape bhi data jaisa hi hai. December 2024 mein Union government ne Supreme Court ko bataya ki usne school jaane wali ladkiyon ke liye ek national menstrual hygiene policy frame ki hai [[livelaw-sc-menstrual-reserved-2024]]. 30 January 2026 ko court ne kaha ki menstrual health, Article 21 ke right to life ka hissa hai, aur apne directions schools ko diye: paani wale working toilets, free sanitary napkins, safe disposal [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]]. Ladkiyon ke liye yeh real gains hain. Par jo women survey ke age band se bahar hain, woh classroom se bhi bahar hain.

## India ko kya ginna shuru karna chahiye

Iske liye koi nayi science nahi chahiye, bas teen decisions chahiye.

Pehla: period protection ka data har us woman ke liye report ho jo menstruate karti hai, sirf 15-24 saal waliyon ke liye nahi, aur saath mein pain, heavy bleeding aur miss hue dinon par sawaal jode jaayein. Doosra: PCOS study fixed intervals par repeat ho, uska age range bada ho, aur results teeno criteria ke saath publish hon. Teesra: hospitals har endometriosis diagnosis record karein, woman ki age aur uske wait ke saalon ke saath, taaki India ke paas apna number ho aur woh global number udhaar lena band kare.

Tab tak apna data khud rakho. Teen mahine tak dates, pain, bleeding aur miss hue din likho, aur yeh record doctor ke paas le jao. Common hona aur normal hona same nahi hai, aur likha hua record jaldbaazi wali consultation mein bole gaye ek sentence se zyada mushkil se taala jaata hai.

intimate-washes-douching-discharge-myths.en:
Three voices teach an Indian girl about her vagina before any doctor does. An advertisement says it needs a special pH wash to stay "fresh". A mother or an aunt says that "safed paani", white discharge, is draining her strength. And her own embarrassment says that itching must be a punishment for something. All three are wrong. Together they keep girls rinsing, hiding and guessing at the chemist instead of getting checked.

## Myth: discharge means weakness or infection

**The claim:** white discharge is the body leaking strength, and a girl who has it will turn thin, tired and weak.

**The truth:** clear or white discharge is how the vagina keeps itself clean and moist. It often begins some months before the first period. It changes through the menstrual cycle: thin and stretchy around ovulation, thicker and whiter at other times. It is not lost nutrition, and it does not cause backache, weakness or weight loss.

The belief does damage in two directions. A girl who is tired because of anaemia or poor sleep has her discharge "treated" while the real cause goes unchecked. A girl with nothing wrong spends years believing her body is faulty.

## Myth: the vagina needs washing inside

**The claim:** a clean woman washes inside, and a special wash, spray or steam keeps infection away.

**The truth:** the vagina maintains its own balance of protective bacteria and acidity. Douching (washing inside), scented washes, deodorant sprays and steaming can disturb that balance and irritate the skin. The NHS advises against douches and perfumed soaps, gels and washes [[nhs-thrush]].

What it needs is less. Wash only the outside, the vulva, with plain water. A mild unscented soap on the outer skin is fine. Dry properly, wear cotton underwear and change out of damp clothes [[nhs-thrush]]. Every healthy vagina has a mild smell of its own. A strong or fishy smell is a reason to see a doctor, not to wash harder.

> An ad that first tells you your body smells wrong, and then sells you the cure, is marketing. It is not medicine.

## Myth: itching means you are 'dirty'

**The claim:** itching or unusual discharge means a girl has poor hygiene, or has "been with someone".

**The truth:** the two most common causes are thrush and bacterial vaginosis (BV), and neither is classed as a sexually transmitted infection. Thrush is an overgrowth of a yeast that normally lives in the body. People who have never had sex get it. Antibiotics, pregnancy and diabetes can set it off [[nhs-thrush]]. BV is a shift in the vagina's own bacteria, and douching and scented washes make it more likely. Some of the itching, in other words, is caused by the "hygiene" products.

Imagine a 17-year-old in Jaipur who starts itching after a course of antibiotics. She cannot tell her mother, who will ask what she has "done". So she tries a cream a friend suggests, then an intimate wash from an ad. She is hypothetical, but the route is real: shame turns a treatable yeast infection into weeks of guesswork.

## Truth: common infections and their treatment

Nobody can tell the cause by looking, and that includes you. These are the patterns worth showing a doctor:

| What you notice | What it may be |
|---|---|
| Thick, curd-like white discharge with itching | Thrush |
| Thin greyish discharge with a fishy smell | Bacterial vaginosis |
| Yellow, green or frothy discharge, sores, or burning when you urinate | Possibly an STI |
| Lower-belly pain, fever, or bleeding between periods or after sex | Needs prompt care |

Each has a different medicine, so a cream bought on a friend's advice often treats the wrong thing.

Some STIs cause discharge or itching. Many cause no symptoms at all, so only a test can tell, and the bacterial ones are curable [[who-sti]]. They are also ordinary. India's AIDS programme managed about 1.12 crore (111.8 lakh) cases of STI/RTI, meaning sexually transmitted and reproductive tract infections, in 2024-25. Of the 71.95 lakh visits to government Suraksha Clinics, 60.9% were by women [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Read those numbers with care. They count episodes and visits, not individual people, and they leave out everyone treated by a private doctor, by a quack, or by nobody. Even so, they show that these complaints are routine work in a government clinic, and that most of the people walking in with them are women.

## Where to get checked

**Suraksha Clinics.** The National AIDS Control Organisation runs 1,127 of these clinics at district hospitals and medical colleges. Below district level, primary and community health centres handle the same infections [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. You do not need to be married, and you can ask whether a female doctor is available.

**Adolescent Friendly Health Centres.** For teenagers, these offer counselling and clinical care at primary and community health centres, district hospitals and medical colleges [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]].

**If you are under 18.** Most causes of discharge and itching have nothing to do with sex, and you owe nobody an explanation for having them. But know the law: under POCSO, any sexual act with a person under 18 is an offence whatever was agreed, and anyone who learns of one, doctors included, must report it [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. A doctor cannot promise a minor total secrecy. You are still entitled to care.

**Cervical screening, for adult women.** This is a different check, which looks for changes in the cervix years before they become cancer [[who-cervical]]. Only 1.2% of Indian women aged 15-49 had ever had it in 2019-21 [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. If you are an adult and already at the clinic, ask when you are due. Bleeding between periods or after sex needs checking at any age.

A vagina needs water on the outside, cotton underwear, and a doctor when something changes. It does not need perfume, steam or shame.
intimate-washes-douching-discharge-myths.hg:
