Unlabelled "mass gainers" sold online can hide the same drugs. Infertility already affects about 1 in 6 adults worldwide at some point in life [[who-infertility-estimates-2023]]. Do not add to the odds for a photo.

## Getting a check-up without shame

NACO runs 1,127 Suraksha Clinics at district hospitals and medical colleges [[naco-sankalak-2025]], set up specifically to test and treat sexually transmitted and reproductive tract infections. The national AIDS helpline, 1097, offers confidential counselling round the clock in 16 languages [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Teenagers can go to an Adolescent Friendly Health Centre, found at primary and community health centres, district hospitals and medical colleges [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]]. For a lump or a foreskin problem, any government hospital's surgery or urology department will see you. You can ask for a male doctor.

Avoid anyone who diagnoses "weakness" from your urine, promises a guaranteed cure or sells a secret formula. A real doctor examines you, explains what they found and tells you what the tests are for.

The boy in Bhopal did not need courage. He needed to have been told, once, that testicle pain at 2 am means hospital, not morning.
testicles-foreskin-steroids-men-checks.hg:
Bhopal ke ek 16 saal ke ladke ko imagine karo jo raat 2 baje ek testicle mein achanak tez dard se uthta hai. Itna dard usne pehle kabhi mehsoos nahi kiya, lekin woh papa ko jagaakar yeh nahi bata paata ki dard kahan ho raha hai. Woh subah tak wait karne ka decide karta hai. Sharm mein liya gaya yeh faisla use apna testicle gawaane tak le ja sakta hai. Yeh guide un checks ke baare mein hai jo Indian ladke aur mard skip karte hain, aur un kuch moments ke baare mein jab skip karna khatarnaak hai.

## Mard check-up kyun nahi karwate

Ladke bachpan se seekhte hain ki "mard ko dard nahi hota" aur kamar ke neeche ki kisi cheez par baat nahi hoti. Koi unhe nahi sikhata ki unki apni body kaisi dikhni aur kaisi feel honi chahiye.

Government data dikhata hai ki sexual-health clinic mein kaun aata hai. India ke designated STI clinics, jinhe Suraksha Clinics kaha jaata hai, mein 2024-25 mein 71.95 lakh visits record hui, aur unme se 60.9% women ki thi [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Yeh clinics reproductive tract infections ka bhi ilaaj karte hain jo women mein common hain, isliye thoda gap expected hai. Lekin unhi clinics mein syphilis screening mein mardon ke 1.54% tests reactive aaye, jo women ke 0.48% se teen guna se bhi zyada hai, aur transgender clients mein 4.12% [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Yeh clinic aane wale log hain, poori population nahi, lekin pattern saaf hai: mard kam aate hain, aur jo aate hain unka test zyada positive aata hai.

Bahut se mard iske bajaye deewaron aur phone screens par advertise hone wale "gupt rog" aur "sex problem" clinics mein chale jaate hain. Drugs and Magic Remedies Act, 1954 ke under sexual impotence ya venereal diseases jaisi conditions ka ilaaj claim karne wali dawaiyon ka ad dena crime hai, jiski pehli conviction par chhe mahine tak jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]]. March 2025 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki "no implementation of the 1954 Act in its true letter and spirit", yaani law sach mein laagu hi nahi hua, aur states ko enforcement aur complaint systems banane ka order diya [[sc-ima-order-mar-2025]].

## Testicles kaise check karein

Testicular cancer common nahi hai, lekin yeh zyada tar young aur middle-aged mardon ko hota hai, theek wahi group jo doctors se bachta hai. Iska sabse common sign ek testicle mein bina dard ka lump ya swelling hai; scrotum mein bhaaripan aur halka dard bhi signs ho sakte hain [[nhs-testicular]]. Jaldi pakda jaaye toh iska ilaaj bahut successful hota hai.

Mahine mein ek baar check karo, garam paani se nahaane ke baad, jab scrotum relaxed ho:

- Scrotum ko hatheli mein lo aur har testicle ko angoothe aur ungliyon ke beech dheere se ghumao.
- Koi lump, sakht hissa, swelling, ya size ya firmness mein badlaav feel karo.
- Normal kya hai, yeh jaano: aksar ek testicle thoda neeche latakta hai ya thoda bada hota hai, aur har ek ke peeche ki naram, ghumavdaar tube (epididymis) wahan honi hi chahiye.

Naya lump emergency nahi hai, aur zyada tar lumps cancer nahi nikalte. Lekin yeh sirf doctor bata sakta hai, isliye appointment dinon mein lo, mahino mein nahi.

## Woh dard jo subah tak wait nahi kar sakta

Ek testicle mein achanak, tez dard, kabhi-kabhi swelling, pet dard, ulti jaisa feel ya ulti ke saath, testicular torsion ho sakta hai: testicle apni cord par ghoom jaata hai aur apni hi blood supply kaat deta hai. Yeh teenage ladkon mein sabse common hai, aur neend mein ya khelte hue bhi ho sakta hai.

Torsion surgical emergency hai. Kuch ghanton ke andar operation testicle bacha sakta hai; subah tak wait karne ka matlab use kho dena ho sakta hai. Turant hospital ke emergency department jao, ya ambulance ke liye 112 call karo. Infection aur chot se bhi aisa dard ho sakta hai, aur unka bhi usi din check-up zaroori hai. Doctors shock nahi honge; unke liye yeh routine emergency kaam hai.

## Foreskin, hygiene aur steroids

Chhote ladkon mein tight foreskin normal hai. Yeh saalon mein apne aap dheela hota hai, kabhi-kabhi teenage tak bhi nahi, aur ise kabhi zabardasti peeche nahi karna chahiye [[nhs-tight-foreskin]]. Agar tight foreskin se dard, laali, swelling, discharge ya peshaab karne mein dikkat ho, toh doctor ko dikhao. Agar foreskin peeche khinch kar penis ke head ke peeche phans jaaye, toh yeh emergency hai [[nhs-tight-foreskin]].

Roz foreskin ke neeche garam paani se saaf karo aur harsh soap se bacho. Foreskin ke neeche khujli, laali aur safed discharge thrush ho sakta hai, ek common fungal infection jiska ilaaj ho jaata hai aur jo hamesha sex se nahi failta [[nhs-thrush]].

Phir aata hai gym. Anabolic steroids aur testosterone injections body ko signal dete hain ki uske paas zaroorat se zyada testosterone hai, toh body apna banana band kar deti hai. Testicles sikud sakte hain, sperm banna kam ho sakta hai, aur kuch mardon ki chest mein swelling aa jaati hai. Steroids chhodne ke baad fertility wapas aane mein mahine lag sakte hain, aur ho sakta hai poori tarah wapas na aaye. Online bikne wale bina label ke "mass gainers" mein bhi yahi drugs chhupe ho sakte hain. Duniya bhar mein lagbhag har 6 mein se 1 adult zindagi mein kabhi na kabhi infertility face karta hai [[who-infertility-estimates-2023]]. Ek photo ke liye yeh risk mat badhao.

## Bina sharm ke check-up kaise karwayein

NACO district hospitals aur medical colleges mein 1,127 Suraksha Clinics chalata hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]], jo khaas taur par sexually transmitted aur reproductive tract infections ki testing aur ilaaj ke liye bane hain. National AIDS helpline 1097 din-raat 16 bhashaon mein confidential counselling deti hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Teenagers Adolescent Friendly Health Centre ja sakte hain, jo primary aur community health centres, district hospitals aur medical colleges mein hote hain [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]]. Lump ya foreskin ki problem ke liye kisi bhi government hospital ka surgery ya urology department tumhe dekhega. Tum male doctor maang sakte ho.

Jo bhi tumhare peshaab se "kamzori" diagnose kare, guaranteed cure ka promise kare ya koi secret formula beche, usse door raho. Asli doctor tumhe examine karta hai, batata hai ki use kya mila, aur samjhata hai ki tests kis liye hain.

Bhopal wale ladke ko himmat ki zaroorat nahi thi. Use bas kisi ne ek baar bataya hona chahiye tha ki raat 2 baje testicle mein dard ka matlab hospital hai, subah nahi.

unmarried-at-the-gynaecologist.en:
Imagine a 24-year-old in Bhopal whose periods come every two or three months. Her acne never settled after college, and she removes chin hair every week. A gynaecologist's number has sat in her phone for a year. She has not called, because she can already hear the questions. "Shaadi hui hai?" Will the form want a husband's name? Will someone mention it to her mother? She is imaginary. The silence is not. Here is what the law says and what a visit involves. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Why unmarried women stay away

The Health Ministry acknowledged this fear in October 2025, when it renamed its "Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics" as "Centres". Adolescents hesitated to visit, it said, because a visit to a "clinic" was "looked upon with suspicion" [[mohfw-afhc-rename-2025]]. National guidance also says these centres should not sit near labour rooms or STI and HIV testing centres, so young people can walk in without hesitation [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]].

If one word on a signboard can keep teenagers out, think of what a waiting room full of pregnant women and a form that asks "Mrs or Miss" do to a single woman of 24. She feels she has to justify being there at all. So do many trans men and non-binary people who need the same care.

That feeling costs health. WHO estimates that up to 70% of women with PCOS worldwide do not know they have it [[who-pcos-factsheet-2026]].

## Your consent, your privacy: what the law says

Indian law's clearest statements about unmarried women's bodies come from abortion law. They set the standard for any visit.

- **Your consent is enough.** Under the MTP Act, an adult woman's own consent is the only consent an abortion needs; a guardian's written consent is required only if she is under 18 or mentally ill [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. No husband, parent or partner has to sign.
- **The law assumes single women use contraception.** Since 2021, the Act's contraceptive-failure ground covers "any woman or her partner", not only a married woman or her husband [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].
- **Marriage is not a test.** On 29 September 2022 the Supreme Court called the distinction between married and single women "artificial" and "not constitutionally sustainable" [[sc-x-principal-secretary-2022]].
- **Secrecy is a legal duty.** Section 5A of the MTP Act bars a doctor from revealing the name or details of a woman whose pregnancy was ended, except to a person authorised by law, on pain of up to one year in prison, a fine or both [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].
- **No HIV test without your say.** The HIV Act, 2017 forbids testing without informed consent, and no one can be compelled to disclose their HIV status except by a court order [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]].

Our Q&A on abortion and privacy covers who may be told what.

One limit is real. POCSO treats everyone under 18 as a child, so any sexual act with a 16- or 17-year-old is an offence whatever was agreed, and anyone who knows of it must report it; failing to report can mean up to 6 months in prison, a fine or both [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. A doctor cannot promise a minor total secrecy about that. You can still go, and ask at the start what the doctor would have to report.

## What happens at a first visit

Most first visits are a conversation: when your periods started, cycle length, pain, bleeding, discharge, medicines, family history. Expect weight and blood pressure checks, perhaps blood tests or an ultrasound.

Then comes the question that matters medically: have you ever had sex? Not "are you married". The answer decides whether a pregnancy test, STI tests or an internal examination make sense. If you have never had penetrative sex, say so: doctors can often scan over the belly instead of internally.

If you want contraception, say that too; choosing a method is a medical conversation, not a moral one. If a condom has just failed, emergency contraception works up to five days after sex, and sooner is better [[who-ec]].

Any internal examination needs your consent. You can ask why, ask for a woman attendant to be present and ask the doctor to stop at any point. No examination can show whether you have had sex. In 2022 the Supreme Court said the "two-finger test" has no scientific basis and directed a review of medical curricula so that it is not prescribed [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]].

## Handling judgmental questions

You can keep the visit about your health:

- "I'm here about irregular periods. Please treat the symptom."
- "I'm not married. I am (or am not) sexually active."
- "Why do you need to know that?" A good doctor will explain.
- "Please don't discuss this with my family."

If a doctor moralises, pay, leave and see someone else. For infections, NACO runs 1,127 Suraksha Clinics, its designated STI/RTI clinics, at district hospitals and medical colleges [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Many STIs cause no symptoms at all; only a test can tell [[who-sti]].

## Conditions you should not ignore

PCOS is the clearest case. An ICMR-funded national study published in 2024 found it in 7.2% of women aged 18-40 by the strictest criteria, 13.6% by a middle definition and 19.6% by the broadest [[jama-netw-open-pcos-india-2024]]. It is not just a period problem. Among the women with PCOS in that study, 43.2% had obesity, 91.9% had abnormal blood lipids, 32.9% had fatty liver disease and 24.9% had metabolic syndrome [[jama-netw-open-pcos-india-2024]]. Waiting until "after marriage", or until you try for a baby, means years of untreated risk.

Do not sit on these either: pain that stops your normal life (our endometriosis explainer shows why it gets dismissed), bleeding heavy enough to soak through pads quickly or leave you dizzy, a late period after sex, and sores, itching, a bad smell or burning when you pass urine.

Only 1.2% of Indian women aged 15-49 had ever been screened for cervical cancer in 2019-21 [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Ask your doctor when you should start. Your body does not wait for a wedding date, and your care should not either.
unmarried-at-the-gynaecologist.hg:
Socho, Bhopal ki ek 24 saal ki ladki, jiske periods do-teen mahine mein ek baar aate hain. College ke baad bhi uska acne theek nahi hua, aur woh har hafte chin ke baal hataati hai. Ek gynaecologist ka number saal bhar se uske phone mein pada hai. Usne call nahi kiya, kyunki sawaal use abhi se sunaai dete hain. "Shaadi hui hai?" Kya form mein husband ka naam maanga jayega? Kya koi uski mummy se zikr kar dega? Yeh ladki kalpana hai. Yeh chuppi kalpana nahi hai. Aage padho ki law kya kehta hai aur ek visit mein kya hota hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Unmarried women door kyun rehti hain

Health Ministry ne yeh darr October 2025 mein khud maana, jab usne apne "Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics" ka naam badal kar "Centres" kar diya. Ministry ne kaha ki adolescents wahan jaane se hichkichaate the, kyunki "clinic" jaane ko "looked upon with suspicion", yaani shak ki nazar se dekha jaata tha [[mohfw-afhc-rename-2025]]. National guidance yeh bhi kehti hai ki yeh centres labour rooms ya STI aur HIV testing centres ke paas nahi hone chahiye, taaki young log bina hichkichaahat ke andar aa sakein [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]].

Agar signboard ka ek shabd teenagers ko bahar rakh sakta hai, toh socho ki pregnant women se bhara waiting room aur "Mrs ya Miss" poochne wala form 24 saal ki single woman par kya asar karta hoga. Use lagta hai ki wahan hone ki bhi safaai deni padegi. Yahi un bahut se trans men aur non-binary logon ko bhi lagta hai jinhe yahi care chahiye.

Is feeling ki keemat health chukaati hai. WHO ka estimate hai ki duniya bhar mein PCOS wali 70% tak women ko pata hi nahi ki unhe yeh hai [[who-pcos-factsheet-2026]].

## Tumhari consent, tumhari privacy: law kya kehta hai

Unmarried women ki body ke baare mein Indian law ki sabse saaf baatein abortion law se aati hain. Wahi kisi bhi visit ka standard set karti hain.

- **Tumhari consent kaafi hai.** MTP Act mein adult woman ki apni consent hi woh akeli consent hai jo abortion ke liye chahiye; guardian ki likhit consent sirf tab chahiye jab woh 18 se kam ho ya mentally ill ho [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. Kisi husband, parent ya partner ko sign nahi karna.
- **Law maanta hai ki single women contraception use karti hain.** 2021 se Act ka contraceptive-failure ground "any woman or her partner" ko cover karta hai, sirf married woman ya uske husband ko nahi [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].
- **Shaadi koi test nahi hai.** 29 September 2022 ko Supreme Court ne married aur single women ke beech ke farq ko "artificial" aur "not constitutionally sustainable" kaha, yaani banawati, aur Constitution ke saamne tikne layak nahi [[sc-x-principal-secretary-2022]].
- **Raaz rakhna legal duty hai.** MTP Act ka Section 5A doctor ko us woman ka naam ya details batane se rokta hai jiski pregnancy end ki gayi, siwaay us insaan ke jise law ne authorise kiya ho. Yeh rule todne par ek saal tak ki jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].
- **Tumhari haan ke bina HIV test nahi.** HIV Act, 2017 informed consent ke bina testing par rok lagata hai, aur court order ke bina kisi ko apna HIV status batane par majboor nahi kiya ja sakta [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]].

Abortion aur privacy par hamara Q&A batata hai ki kise kya bataya ja sakta hai.

Ek limit asli hai. POCSO 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko child maanta hai, isliye 16 ya 17 saal ke kisi insaan ke saath koi bhi sexual act offence hai, chahe aapas mein kuch bhi tay hua ho, aur jise bhi iska pata ho use report karna hota hai; report na karne par 6 mahine tak ki jail, fine ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Doctor kisi minor se is baare mein poori secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakta. Tum phir bhi ja sakti ho, aur shuru mein hi pooch sakti ho ki doctor ko kya report karna padega.

## Pehli visit mein kya hota hai

Zyada tar pehli visits ek baatcheet hoti hain: periods kab shuru hue, cycle kitni lambi hai, pain, bleeding, discharge, dawaiyan, family history. Weight aur blood pressure check hoga, shayad blood tests ya ultrasound bhi.

Phir aata hai woh sawaal jo medically matter karta hai: kya tumne kabhi sex kiya hai? "Shaadi hui hai?" nahi. Isi jawaab se tay hota hai ki pregnancy test, STI tests ya internal examination ka koi matlab hai ya nahi. Agar tumne kabhi penetrative sex nahi kiya, toh bata do: doctors aksar internal scan ki jagah pet ke upar se scan kar sakte hain.

Agar tumhe contraception chahiye, toh woh bhi bolo; method chunna ek medical baatcheet hai, moral nahi. Agar abhi-abhi condom fail hua hai, toh emergency contraception sex ke paanch din baad tak kaam karti hai, aur jitni jaldi utna behtar [[who-ec]].

Kisi bhi internal examination ke liye tumhari consent chahiye. Tum pooch sakti ho ki kyun, woman attendant ko saath rakhne ko keh sakti ho, aur kisi bhi waqt doctor ko rukne ko keh sakti ho. Koi bhi examination yeh nahi dikha sakta ki tumne sex kiya hai ya nahi. 2022 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki "two-finger test" ka koi scientific basis nahi hai, aur medical curricula ka review karne ka direction diya taaki yeh test prescribe na kiya jaye [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]].

## Judgmental sawaalon ko handle karna

Tum visit ko apni health par tika kar rakh sakti ho:

- "Main irregular periods ke liye aayi hoon. Please symptom ka ilaaj kijiye."
- "Meri shaadi nahi hui hai. Main sexually active hoon (ya nahi hoon)."
- "Aapko yeh jaanna kyun zaroori hai?" Achha doctor wajah samjha dega.
- "Please yeh baat meri family se discuss mat kijiye."

Agar doctor moral lecture de, toh fees do, niklo aur kisi aur ko dikhao. Infections ke liye NACO district hospitals aur medical colleges mein 1,127 Suraksha Clinics chalata hai, jo uske designated STI/RTI clinics hain [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Bahut se STIs mein koi symptom hota hi nahi; sirf test se pata chalta hai [[who-sti]].

## Yeh conditions ignore mat karo

PCOS sabse saaf example hai. 2024 mein chhapi ek ICMR-funded national study ne ise 18-40 saal ki women mein sabse strict criteria se 7.2% mein, beech ki definition se 13.6% mein aur sabse broad criteria se 19.6% mein paaya [[jama-netw-open-pcos-india-2024]]. Yeh sirf periods ki problem nahi hai. Us study ki PCOS wali women mein 43.2% ko obesity thi, 91.9% ke blood lipids abnormal the, 32.9% ko fatty liver disease thi aur 24.9% ko metabolic syndrome tha [[jama-netw-open-pcos-india-2024]]. "Shaadi ke baad" tak, ya baby plan karne tak rukne ka matlab hai saalon ka untreated risk.

Inhe bhi mat taalo: aisa pain jo tumhari normal life rok de (endometriosis par hamara explainer dikhata hai ki ise kyun halke mein liya jaata hai), itni heavy bleeding ki pads jaldi-jaldi bheeg jayein ya chakkar aane lagein, sex ke baad late hua period, aur ghaav, khujli, badboo ya urine karte waqt jalan.

2019-21 mein 15-49 saal ki sirf 1.2% Indian women ki kabhi cervical cancer screening hui thi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Apne doctor se poocho ki tumhe screening kab shuru karni chahiye. Tumhari body shaadi ki date ka intezaar nahi karti, aur tumhari care ko bhi nahi karna chahiye.

used-sanitary-pads-disposal.en:
Between two rounds of the National Family Health Survey, the share of women aged 15-24 who used sanitary napkins rose from 41.8% in 2015-16 [[nfhs4-india-2016]] to 64.4% in 2019-21 [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. It is a real health gain, and it means far more used pads every month. The survey asks what a woman uses. It does not ask where the used pad goes, and in much of India nobody built an answer.

## A health gain that created waste

In 2015-16, 62.1% of young women used cloth and 57.6% used a method the survey counts as hygienic [[nfhs4-india-2016]]. By 2019-21 cloth was down to 49.6% and the "hygienic" share was up to 77.6% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Many women use more than one method, so the figures overlap.

Cloth is washed and used again. A disposable pad is worn for a few hours and thrown away, several a day, for the 2 to 7 days a period usually lasts [[nhs-periods]], every month from the early teens to menopause.

## What happens to a used pad

A typical disposable pad has a plastic back sheet, a synthetic top layer and an absorbent core of pulp and gel. Unlike cotton cloth, those parts do not rot away in a pit or a field.

- In the household bin, it joins mixed garbage, which a municipal worker or a waste picker sorts by hand.
- Flushed, it swells and blocks the toilet or the sewer line, and a sanitation worker has to clear it.
- Thrown into a drain, a pond or a field, it stays there.
- Burnt in the open with other rubbish, its plastic gives off toxic smoke.

Shame often decides which of these happens. A 2016 review of Indian studies found that 77% of adolescent girls were kept from religious activities during their periods [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. Where the blood is treated as polluting, a used pad is something nobody at home may see. It is often wrapped in black polythene and dropped after dark where no one will ask whose it is.

Consider a Class 9 student in a government school in Sitapur whose toilet has no bin. She can wear the same pad until she gets home, carry the used one in her school bag, or drop it in the toilet pan. The third choice blocks the toilet, the toilet gets locked, and the next girl has nowhere to change at all.

## Oxo-biodegradable, biodegradable, compostable: what the labels mean

The Supreme Court's judgment of 30 January 2026 in Dr Jaya Thakur v. Government of India directed free distribution of "oxo biodegradable" sanitary napkins in schools [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]]. On 1 September 2026 the court changed that standard to biodegradable or compostable pads, to be read against an international compostability standard together with the Indian standard for sanitary napkins [[sc-jaya-thakur-order-sept-2026]].

The three words mean different things.

- **Oxo-biodegradable** plastic is ordinary plastic with additives that make it break apart faster in heat, light and air. Breaking apart is not disappearing: the worry is that it becomes smaller pieces of plastic.
- **Biodegradable** means microbes can break the material down. The word alone does not say how long that takes or what conditions it needs.
- **Compostable** is the stricter claim: the material has been tested against a standard to break down under composting conditions within a set time.

The change covers the free pads ordered for schools, not every packet in a shop. And no label changes the basics: a compostable pad breaks down in a compost system, not in a drain or a knotted plastic bag, and no pad should ever be flushed.

## What schools must now provide

The January judgment held that menstrual health is part of the right to life under Article 21. It directed every school to provide working, separate toilets for girls with water, free sanitary napkins and safe disposal systems [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]].

The buildings are behind. In an affidavit of 31 August 2026 the Centre told the court that of 39,439 girls' toilets identified as needing to be made functional, 30,458 had been built, 4,236 were under construction and 4,745 were still a gap [[sc-jaya-thakur-order-sept-2026]]. A toilet that does not work cannot have a disposal system. The court said it was "discontent with the manner in which compliance is reported" [[sc-jaya-thakur-order-sept-2026]]. In an order reported on 15 October 2026 it gave states "one last opportunity" and warned of contempt notices to their Chief Secretaries; the case is listed next on 14 December 2026 [[livelaw-sc-menstrual-contempt-oct-2026]].

A student can test her own school in a minute. Is there a covered bin inside the girls' toilet? Is it emptied every day? Does anyone know where that waste goes next?

## Disposal that respects the people who clean up

- Wrap the used pad in paper or in the wrapper of the next pad, put it in a covered bin and wash your hands.
- Never flush it, burn it in the open or throw it into a drain, a field or water.
- Where sanitary waste is collected separately, keep it apart from kitchen waste. Elsewhere, mark the wrapped packet so that the person sorting the garbage knows not to open it.

Reusable products cut the waste at the source. A menstrual cup can be washed and used again, and period underwear and cloth pads are made to be washed and reused [[nhs-periods]]. They need clean water, soap and a private place to dry, which many girls do not have. Nobody should be shamed for using a disposable pad.

At the end of this chain is a sanitation worker or a waste picker who opens the bag by hand. Ask your school, hostel or housing society for three things: a covered bin in every women's toilet, daily collection, and gloves for the staff who empty it.

India measured how many women got a pad. It has yet to build what each of those pads needs afterwards: a bin, a collection route and protection for the worker at the end of it.
used-sanitary-pads-disposal.hg:
National Family Health Survey ke do rounds ke beech, 15-24 saal ki women mein sanitary napkins ka use 2015-16 ke 41.8% [[nfhs4-india-2016]] se badh kar 2019-21 mein 64.4% ho gaya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yeh health ke liye sach mein achhi khabar hai, aur iska matlab yeh bhi hai ki har mahine pehle se kahin zyada used pads nikalte hain. Survey poochta hai ki woman kya use karti hai. Yeh nahi poochta ki used pad jaata kahan hai, aur India ke kai hisson mein iska jawab kisi ne banaya hi nahi.

## Health ka fayda, jisne kachra bhi badhaya

2015-16 mein 62.1% young women cloth use karti thi aur 57.6% aisa method jise survey hygienic ginta hai [[nfhs4-india-2016]]. 2019-21 tak cloth ghat kar 49.6% reh gaya aur "hygienic" wala share badh kar 77.6% ho gaya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Kai women ek se zyada method use karti hain, isliye yeh figures overlap karte hain.

Kapda dhul kar dobara use hota hai. Disposable pad kuch ghante pehna jaata hai aur phenk diya jaata hai, din mein kai, un 2 se 7 dinon tak jitna ek period aam taur par chalta hai [[nhs-periods]], aur yeh har mahine, early teens se menopause tak.

## Used pad ka hota kya hai

Ek aam disposable pad mein plastic ki back sheet, synthetic top layer aur pulp aur gel ka absorbent core hota hai. Cotton ke kapde ki tarah yeh hisse kisi gaddhe ya khet mein gal kar khatam nahi hote.

- Ghar ke dustbin mein woh mixed kachre mein mil jaata hai, jise koi municipal worker ya waste picker haath se chhaant kar alag karta hai.
- Flush karne par woh phool jaata hai aur toilet ya sewer line block kar deta hai, aur phir kisi sanitation worker ko use saaf karna padta hai.
- Naali, talaab ya khet mein phenka jaaye toh wahin pada rehta hai.
- Doosre kachre ke saath khule mein jalaya jaaye toh uske plastic se zehreela dhuaan nikalta hai.

Inme se kya hoga, yeh aksar sharam decide karti hai. 2016 ke ek review ne India ki studies ko jod kar dekha aur paaya ki 77% adolescent girls ko periods ke dauraan religious activities se roka jaata tha [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. Jahan period ke blood ko ashuddh maana jaata hai, wahan used pad aisi cheez ban jaata hai jo ghar mein kisi ko dikhni nahi chahiye. Use aksar kaali polythene mein lapet kar andhera hone ke baad wahan phenk diya jaata hai jahan koi na pooche ki yeh kiska hai.

Sitapur ke ek sarkari school ki Class 9 ki student ke baare mein socho, jiske toilet mein dustbin nahi hai. Woh ya toh ghar pahunchne tak wahi pad pehne rahe, ya used pad apne school bag mein le jaaye, ya use toilet pan mein daal de. Teesra raasta toilet block kar deta hai, toilet par taala lag jaata hai, aur agli ladki ke paas pad badalne ki koi jagah hi nahi bachti.

## Oxo-biodegradable, biodegradable, compostable: labels ka matlab kya hai

Supreme Court ke 30 January 2026 ke judgment, Dr Jaya Thakur v. Government of India, ne schools mein "oxo biodegradable" sanitary napkins free baantne ka direction diya tha [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]]. 1 September 2026 ko court ne yeh standard badal kar biodegradable ya compostable pads kar diya, jise compostability ke ek international standard aur sanitary napkins ke Indian standard ke saath padha jaayega [[sc-jaya-thakur-order-sept-2026]].

In teeno words ka matlab alag-alag hai.

- **Oxo-biodegradable** plastic aam plastic hi hota hai, jisme aise additives milaye jaate hain ki woh garmi, roshni aur hawa mein jaldi toot jaaye. Par tootna gayab hona nahi hai: chinta yeh hai ki woh plastic ke chhote-chhote tukdon mein badal jaata hai.
- **Biodegradable** ka matlab hai ki microbes us material ko tod sakte hain. Akela yeh word nahi batata ki isme kitna time lagega ya kaunsi conditions chahiye.
- **Compostable** zyada sakht claim hai: material ko ek standard par test kiya gaya hai ki woh composting conditions mein ek tay time ke andar toot jaaye.

Yeh badlaav un free pads par laagu hota hai jinka order schools ke liye diya gaya, dukaan ke har packet par nahi. Aur koi bhi label basics nahi badalta: compostable pad compost system mein toot kar khatam hota hai, naali ya gaanth lagi plastic ki thaili mein nahi, aur koi bhi pad kabhi flush nahi karna chahiye.

## Schools ko ab kya dena hoga

January ke judgment ne kaha ki menstrual health Article 21 ke right to life ka hissa hai. Usne har school ko direction diya ki ladkiyon ke liye alag, chalu toilets hon jinme paani ho, free sanitary napkins milein aur safe disposal systems hon [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]].

Ground par kaam peeche hai. 31 August 2026 ke affidavit mein Centre ne court ko bataya ki ladkiyon ke 39,439 toilets aise identify hue the jinhe chalu karna tha. Inme se 30,458 ban chuke the, 4,236 ban rahe the aur 4,745 ki kami abhi bhi baaki thi [[sc-jaya-thakur-order-sept-2026]]. Jo toilet chalta hi nahi, usme disposal system ho hi nahi sakta. Court ne kaha ki woh "discontent with the manner in which compliance is reported" hai, yaani compliance jis tarah report ho rahi hai usse woh santusht nahi [[sc-jaya-thakur-order-sept-2026]]. 15 October 2026 ko report hue ek order mein court ne states ko "one last opportunity" di aur unke Chief Secretaries ko contempt notice ki warning di; case agli baar 14 December 2026 ko listed hai [[livelaw-sc-menstrual-contempt-oct-2026]].

Koi bhi student ek minute mein apne school ko test kar sakti hai. Kya girls' toilet ke andar dhakkan wala dustbin hai? Kya woh roz khaali hota hai? Kya kisi ko pata hai ki woh kachra uske baad kahan jaata hai?

## Aisa disposal jo safai karne walon ki izzat kare

- Used pad ko paper mein ya agle pad ke wrapper mein lapeto, dhakkan wale dustbin mein daalo aur haath dho lo.
- Use kabhi flush mat karo, khule mein mat jalao, aur naali, khet ya paani mein mat phenko.
- Jahan sanitary waste alag se collect hota hai, wahan use kitchen ke kachre se alag rakho. Baaki jagah lipte hue packet par nishaan laga do, taaki kachra chhaantne wale ko pata rahe ki ise kholna nahi hai.

Reusable products kachre ko shuru mein hi kam kar dete hain. Menstrual cup ko dho kar dobara use kiya ja sakta hai, aur period underwear aur cloth pads dho kar dobara use karne ke liye hi bante hain [[nhs-periods]]. Inke liye saaf paani, sabun aur sukhane ki private jagah chahiye, jo bahut si ladkiyon ke paas nahi hoti. Disposable pad use karne ke liye kisi ko sharminda nahi kiya jaana chahiye.

Is chain ke aakhir mein ek sanitation worker ya waste picker hota hai jo thaili ko haath se kholta hai. Apne school, hostel ya housing society se teen cheezein maango: har women's toilet mein dhakkan wala dustbin, roz ka collection, aur use khaali karne wale staff ke liye gloves.

India ne yeh toh gina ki kitni women tak pad pahuncha. Par har pad ko uske baad jo chahiye, woh banna abhi baaki hai: ek dustbin, collection ka ek raasta, aur us raaste ke aakhir mein khade worker ki suraksha.

virginity-test-hymen-two-finger.en:
There is no medical test for virginity. No doctor, husband, mother-in-law or bedsheet can tell whether a woman has had sex, because the body keeps no such record. The belief that it does rests on one small piece of tissue, the hymen, and on an old habit of treating a woman's past as something other people are entitled to inspect. The Supreme Court has rejected the hospital version of this 'test' twice. Many families still ask for proof.

## What the hymen is, and what it is not

The hymen is a thin, stretchy rim of tissue around the opening of the vagina. It is not a seal waiting to be broken. It normally has an opening from the start, which is how period blood leaves the body.

Its shape and thickness differ from person to person, and some people are born with very little of it. It can stretch or wear down through growth, sport, tampon use or nothing in particular, and it may or may not tear or bleed the first time someone has intercourse [[who-sexual-health]]. Many women do not bleed at all.

So two women with the same history can look different, and two women with different histories can look the same. 'Tightness' proves nothing either: the vagina is a muscular passage that stretches and returns to its shape. No examination of any body, of any gender, can show whether that person has had sex.

> The hymen is tissue, not a certificate. It was never built to record anything.

## From hospital to bedsheet: how 'virginity' gets tested

The same false idea turns up in three rooms.

In the hospital it was the 'two-finger test': an internal examination of a rape survivor that claimed to show whether she was sexually active, as if that could decide whether she had been raped. In the bedroom it is the white sheet inspected the morning after a wedding, where a stain is read as honour and a clean sheet as guilt. In the clinic it is the 'check-up' a family asks for before an engagement, hoping a doctor will certify what no doctor can.

Imagine a 23-year-old in Kanpur, two weeks before her wedding. A relative of the groom suggests a visit to 'a lady doctor, just to be sure'. She has never had sex. She also knows she may not bleed. She spends the fortnight rehearsing a defence instead of planning a marriage. Nothing is asked of the groom, because nobody ever invented a test for him.

The World Health Organization has condemned 'virginity testing' as unscientific and harmful [[who-sexual-health]].

## What the courts said in 2013 and 2022

In April 2013, in Lillu @ Rajesh v. State of Haryana, the Supreme Court held that the two-finger test violates the right of rape survivors to privacy, physical and mental integrity and dignity [[barandbench-lillu-2013]].

The practice did not end there. On 31 October 2022, in State of Jharkhand v. Shailendra Kumar Rai, Justices D.Y. Chandrachud and Hima Kohli heard a case in which a hospital medical board had performed the test. They said it "has no scientific basis and neither proves nor disproves allegations of rape" [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]], and that it "re-victimizes and re-traumatizes" women [[theprint-sc-two-finger-test-2022]]. Anyone who conducts it in breach of the court's directions "shall be guilty of misconduct". Governments were told to send the Health Ministry's 2014 guidelines to every government and private hospital, and to review medical curricula so that the test is not prescribed [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]].

The second ruling is also an admission. Years after the first, the court still had to order guidelines into hospitals and check what medical students were being taught. A myth printed in a textbook does not leave the examination room because a judgment was delivered in Delhi.

## Consent and dignity in a medical exam

The law now writes consent into the examination itself. Under Section 184 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, a rape survivor is to be sent for a medical examination within 24 hours of the police receiving information, only with her consent, and the doctor must send the report to the investigating officer within 7 days. The section adds that nothing in it makes an examination without the woman's consent lawful [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

What the old test claimed to find does not matter in court either. Under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023, a survivor's character or previous sexual experience is irrelevant to the question of consent, and in rape cases she may not be cross-examined about it to prove consent [[indiacode-bsa-2023]]. A proper examination treats injuries, offers care and collects evidence of the offence. It has nothing to say about her past.

Outside a police case the principle is the same. An adult woman cannot be examined because her family, or her fiancé's family, wants it; her own consent is what counts. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Hymen 'repair' and the business of purity

Where there is a demand for proof, someone will sell it. Hymen 'repair', or hymenoplasty, is cosmetic surgery offered to women who fear the wedding night. It has no health benefit, it carries the risks of any surgery, and it cannot guarantee bleeding [[who-sexual-health]].

The women who pay for it are not vain. Many are frightened of what a clean sheet could cost them: a broken engagement, taunts, violence. The surgery, the secrecy and the bill all land on her. The people who hold the belief pay nothing for it.

That is the part readers can change. A groom can tell his family there will be no sheet and no questions. Parents can refuse a 'check-up' for their daughter and never ask one of a daughter-in-law. A doctor asked for a certificate can say there is nothing to certify. A woman being pushed into an examination can call 112 or the Women Helpline, or Child Helpline 1098 if she is under 18.

Nobody's past is written on their body. The demand for proof ends when the people it is staged for stop asking.
virginity-test-hymen-two-finger.hg:
Virginity ka koi medical test nahi hota. Koi doctor, pati, saas ya bedsheet yeh nahi bata sakti ki kisi aurat ne sex kiya hai ya nahi, kyunki body aisa koi record rakhti hi nahi. Yeh belief ki body record rakhti hai, tissue ke ek chhote se tukde par tika hai jise hymen kehte hain, aur us purani aadat par ki aurat ka past doosron ke inspect karne ki cheez hai. Supreme Court is 'test' ke hospital wale version ko do baar reject kar chuka hai. Bahut si families ab bhi proof maangti hain.

## Hymen kya hai, aur kya nahi hai

Hymen vagina ke opening ke aas-paas tissue ka ek patla, stretchy rim hota hai. Yeh koi seal nahi hai jo tootne ka wait kar rahi ho. Isme shuru se hi ek opening hoti hai, isi se period ka blood body se bahar aata hai.

Iski shape aur motai har insaan mein alag hoti hai, aur kuch log bahut kam hymen ke saath paida hote hain. Yeh growth, sports, tampon use ya bina kisi khaas wajah ke stretch ho sakta hai ya ghis sakta hai, aur pehli baar intercourse ke waqt yeh phat bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi, bleed ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi [[who-sexual-health]]. Bahut si women ko bilkul bleeding nahi hoti.

Matlab ek jaisi history wali do women alag dikh sakti hain, aur alag history wali do women ek jaisi. 'Tightness' bhi kuch prove nahi karti: vagina ek muscular passage hai jo stretch hota hai aur wapas apni shape mein aa jaata hai. Kisi bhi body ka, kisi bhi gender ka, koi examination yeh nahi dikha sakta ki us insaan ne sex kiya hai ya nahi.

> Hymen tissue hai, certificate nahi. Yeh kuch record karne ke liye bana hi nahi tha.

## Hospital se bedsheet tak: 'virginity' kaise test hoti hai

Yahi galat idea teen kamron mein milta hai.

Hospital mein yeh 'two-finger test' tha: rape survivor ka ek internal examination, jo yeh dikhane ka daava karta tha ki woh sexually active hai ya nahi, jaise isse yeh tay ho sakta ho ki uske saath rape hua ya nahi. Bedroom mein yeh shaadi ki agli subah check hone wali safed chaadar hai, jahan daag ko izzat aur saaf chaadar ko gunaah padha jaata hai. Clinic mein yeh woh 'check-up' hai jo family sagaai se pehle maangti hai, is umeed mein ki doctor woh certify kar dega jo koi doctor certify kar hi nahi sakta.

Kanpur ki ek 23 saal ki ladki ko imagine karo, shaadi se do hafte pehle. Dulhe ka ek rishtedaar suggest karta hai ki ek baar 'lady doctor ko dikha lo, bas tasalli ke liye'. Usne kabhi sex nahi kiya. Use yeh bhi pata hai ki ho sakta hai use bleeding na ho. Woh yeh do hafte shaadi plan karne ke bajaye apni safai rehearse karne mein nikaal deti hai. Dulhe se kuch nahi poochha jaata, kyunki uske liye kabhi kisi ne koi test banaya hi nahi.

World Health Organization ne 'virginity testing' ko unscientific aur harmful bataya hai aur ise condemn kiya hai [[who-sexual-health]].

## Courts ne 2013 aur 2022 mein kya kaha

April 2013 mein, Lillu @ Rajesh v. State of Haryana mein, Supreme Court ne kaha ki two-finger test rape survivors ke privacy, physical aur mental integrity aur dignity ke right ka violation hai [[barandbench-lillu-2013]].

Practice wahin khatam nahi hui. 31 October 2022 ko, State of Jharkhand v. Shailendra Kumar Rai mein, Justices D.Y. Chandrachud aur Hima Kohli ne ek aisa case suna jisme hospital ke medical board ne yeh test kiya tha. Unhone kaha ki yeh test "has no scientific basis and neither proves nor disproves allegations of rape" [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]], aur yeh women ko "re-victimizes and re-traumatizes" karta hai [[theprint-sc-two-finger-test-2022]]. Jo bhi court ke directions tod kar yeh test karega, woh "shall be guilty of misconduct". Governments ko kaha gaya ki Health Ministry ki 2014 ki guidelines har government aur private hospital ko bheji jaayein, aur medical curricula review kiye jaayein taaki yeh test padhaya hi na jaaye [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]].

Doosra faisla ek tarah ka admission bhi hai. Pehle faisle ke saalon baad bhi court ko guidelines hospitals tak pahunchane ka order dena pada aur yeh check karwana pada ki medical students ko kya padhaya ja raha hai. Jo myth textbook mein chhapa ho, woh examination room se sirf isliye nahi nikalta ki Delhi mein ek judgment aa gaya.

## Medical exam mein consent aur dignity

Ab law ne consent ko examination ke andar hi likh diya hai. Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 ke Section 184 ke under, police ko information milne ke 24 hours ke andar rape survivor ko medical examination ke liye bhejna hota hai, sirf uski consent se, aur doctor ko 7 din ke andar report investigating officer ko bhejni hoti hai. Section yeh bhi kehta hai ki isme aisa kuch nahi hai jo aurat ki consent ke bina kiye gaye examination ko lawful bana de [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Purana test jo 'dhoondhne' ka daava karta tha, woh court mein bhi matter nahi karta. Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 ke under, consent ke sawaal par survivor ka character ya previous sexual experience irrelevant hai, aur rape cases mein consent prove karne ke liye usse cross-examination mein iske baare mein poochha nahi ja sakta [[indiacode-bsa-2023]]. Sahi examination injuries ka ilaaj karta hai, care deta hai aur offence ka evidence collect karta hai. Uske past ke baare mein uske paas kehne ko kuch nahi hota.

Police case ke bahar bhi principle wahi hai. Kisi adult aurat ka examination sirf isliye nahi ho sakta ki uski family ya uske mangetar ki family aisa chahti hai; uski apni consent hi count hoti hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Hymen 'repair' aur purity ka business

Jahan proof ki demand hogi, wahan koi use bechega bhi. Hymen 'repair', yaani hymenoplasty, ek cosmetic surgery hai jo un women ko offer ki jaati hai jo shaadi ki raat se darti hain. Iska koi health benefit nahi hai, isme kisi bhi surgery wale risks hain, aur yeh bleeding ki guarantee nahi de sakti [[who-sexual-health]].

Jo women iske paise deti hain, woh shauk ke liye nahi karti. Bahut si sach mein dari hui hoti hain ki saaf chaadar ki keemat kya ho sakti hai: tooti hui sagaai, taane, violence. Surgery, secrecy aur bill, sab usi par aata hai. Jo log yeh belief paalte hain, unhe iski koi keemat nahi chukani padti.

Yahi woh hissa hai jo readers badal sakte hain. Dulha apni family se keh sakta hai ki na koi chaadar check hogi, na koi sawaal hoga. Parents apni beti ka 'check-up' mana kar sakte hain, aur yeh tay kar sakte hain ki bahu se kabhi aisa kuch nahi maangenge. Jis doctor se certificate maanga jaaye, woh keh sakta hai ki certify karne ko kuch hai hi nahi. Jis aurat ko zabardasti examination ki taraf dhakela ja raha ho, woh 112 ya Women Helpline call kar sakti hai, aur 18 se kam umar ho toh Child Helpline 1098.

Kisi ka past uski body par likha nahi hota. Proof ki demand tab khatam hogi jab woh log maangna band kar denge jinke liye yeh tamasha hota hai.

what-schools-owe-girls-periods-ruling.en:
Consider this. A 13-year-old in Class 8 feels her period start during the second lesson. She has no pad. The girls' toilet is locked, or has no water, or has no bin, and her uniform is stained. Until this year, what happened next depended on the kindness of one teacher. Since 30 January 2026, a Supreme Court judgment says what every school must have ready for her. Here it is as a checklist. This is general information, not legal advice.

## What the court decided, in plain words

The case, Dr Jaya Thakur v. Government of India, began in 2022 as a petition for free sanitary napkins and separate toilets for girls in schools [[livelaw-sc-menstrual-reserved-2024]]. On 30 January 2026, Justices J.B. Pardiwala and R. Mahadevan decided it, holding that menstrual health is part of the right to life under Article 21. The court put it plainly: "The right to life includes the right to a dignified existence and the right to menstrual health" [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]].

A free pad and a working toilet are no longer a scheme a school may or may not run. They are what a girl is owed. The directions cover all schools, and the one on free sanitary napkins names government and private schools alike [[sc-jaya-thakur-order-sept-2026]].

## The checklist: what every school must have

Check these on an ordinary school day, not on inspection day [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]]:

- **A working girls' toilet.** Separate from the boys', with usable water and a place to wash hands. A toilet that is locked, dry or used as a storeroom does not meet the order.
- **Free sanitary napkins.** Free means no charge; ask that girls can get one quietly. Since 1 September 2026, the napkins must be biodegradable or compostable, replacing the "oxo-biodegradable" standard in the original judgment [[sc-jaya-thakur-order-sept-2026]].
- **Safe disposal.** A safe system for used pads. In practice, look for a covered bin and ask who is responsible for emptying it.
- **An MHM corner.** MHM means menstrual hygiene management. The corner keeps spare uniforms, so a stain does not send a girl home.
- **Lessons that treat periods as biology.** The court asked NCERT and the state education councils (SCERTs) for gender-responsive curricula.
- **Sessions for boys and male teachers.** See below.
- **Inspections.** District Education Officers are responsible for checking schools.

Why it matters: nearly half of young women in India (49.6%) still used cloth in 2019-21 [[nfhs5-india-2021]], and a 2016 review of Indian studies found that about a quarter of adolescent girls (24%) missed school during their periods [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. Every item on this list removes one reason to stay home.

## Boys and male teachers are part of the order

The judgment asks schools to sensitise boys and male teachers [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]]. Teasing about a stain, a male teacher who refuses a bathroom break, a pad passed around as a joke: these are the moments that teach a girl to stay home.

Silence starts early. Only about half of Indian girls (48%) had been told about menstruation before their first period, the same 2016 review found, pooling the 88 studies that reported on this [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. When girls learn late and boys are sent out of the room, boys learn about periods from jokes.

In government and aided schools, the School Health and Wellness Programme already asks for two teachers, preferably one man and one woman, to be trained as "Health and Wellness Ambassadors" [[pib-school-health-ambassador-curriculum-2020]]. What boys should know is answered in a separate question-and-answer story.

## If your school falls short: who to approach

1. **Write it down.** Note the date, what was missing and for how long. If you take photos, photograph the empty dispenser, the dry tap or the locked door, never a student.
2. **Tell the school in writing.** Give a short letter to the principal and keep a copy. In a government or aided school, copy the two Health and Wellness Ambassador teachers. Name the judgment (Dr Jaya Thakur v. Government of India, 30 January 2026) and ask for a reply by a fixed date.
3. **Go to the District Education Officer.** The court made DEOs responsible for inspections [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]], so a dated letter to the district education office, attaching your letter to the school, is the next step. Private-school students can use this route too, since the ruling covers their schools.
4. **Ask for the record.** Ask the district education office, in writing, what its inspections found at your school.
5. **Know who answers above them.** States must report their compliance to the Supreme Court. In an order reported on 15 October 2026, it gave states "one last opportunity" and warned that it would issue contempt notices to the Chief Secretaries of states that failed to respond; the case is listed next on 14 December 2026 [[livelaw-sc-menstrual-contempt-oct-2026]]. How states stalled is a separate investigation; for you, it means a dated complaint lands in a system the Supreme Court is watching.

If a girl is humiliated or punished because of her period, tell a parent or trusted teacher, or call the child helpline, 1098. For pain or very heavy bleeding, a school is not a clinic: Adolescent Friendly Health Centres at government health centres, district hospitals and medical colleges offer counselling and clinical care [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]].

## What the national policy adds

In December 2024, the Union government told the court that a national menstrual hygiene policy for school-going girls had recently been framed, that states and union territories would have to implement it, and that distribution would run mainly through schools and anganwadis [[livelaw-sc-menstrual-reserved-2024]].

Two things follow. First, delivery is your state's job, so your state government, not only the school, is the right door to knock on. Second, if a school-going girl cannot get pads at school, ask at the nearest anganwadi too.

The policy and the judgment are both about schools. Girls who never went to school are among the least likely to use hygienic period protection [[nfhs5-india-2021]], and they are outside this checklist altogether; that divide is a separate story in this section. A right becomes real when a 13-year-old can get through a school day on her period without anyone's permission or pity.

Socho. Class 8 mein padhne wali 13 saal ki ek ladki hai. School ke doosre ghante mein uske periods shuru ho jaate hain. Uske paas pad nahi hai. Girls' toilet band hai, ya usmein paani nahi, ya dustbin nahi, aur uski uniform par daag lag gaya hai. Is saal tak aage kya hoga, yeh kisi ek teacher ki meharbaani par tika tha. 30 January 2026 se Supreme Court ka ek faisla batata hai ki har school ko uske liye kya-kya ready rakhna hai. Yahan wahi baatein ek checklist ki tarah di gayi hain. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Court ne kya decide kiya, simple shabdon mein

Case hai Dr Jaya Thakur v. Government of India. Yeh 2022 mein ek petition se shuru hua tha, jismein schools mein ladkiyon ke liye free sanitary napkins aur alag toilets maange gaye the [[livelaw-sc-menstrual-reserved-2024]]. 30 January 2026 ko Justices J.B. Pardiwala aur R. Mahadevan ne faisla sunaya ki menstrual health Article 21 ke right to life ka hissa hai. Court ne saaf likha: "The right to life includes the right to a dignified existence and the right to menstrual health", yaani jeene ke haq mein izzat se jeene ka haq aur menstrual health ka haq, dono shaamil hain [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]].

Matlab free pad aur working toilet ab koi aisi scheme nahi jo school chahe toh chalaye, chahe toh nahi. Yeh ladki ka haq hai. Yeh directions saare schools par laagu hote hain, aur free sanitary napkins wale direction mein government aur private, dono tarah ke schools ka naam hai [[sc-jaya-thakur-order-sept-2026]].

## Checklist: har school mein kya hona zaroori hai

Yeh cheezein kisi normal din check karo, inspection wale din nahi [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]]:

- **Working girls' toilet.** Boys se alag ho, usmein use karne layak paani ho aur haath dhone ki jagah ho. Jo toilet band pada hai, sookha hai ya store-room bana diya gaya hai, woh is order par khara nahi utarta.
- **Free sanitary napkins.** Free matlab bina ek bhi paisa liye. Yeh bhi maango ki ladkiyan chupchaap pad le sakein. 1 September 2026 se yeh pads biodegradable ya compostable hone chahiye, yaani aise jo mitti mein ghul-mil jaayein; isne original faisle ke "oxo-biodegradable" standard ki jagah li hai [[sc-jaya-thakur-order-sept-2026]].
- **Safe disposal.** Used pads ke liye koi safe system. Asal mein dekho ki dhakkan wala dustbin hai ya nahi, aur poochho ki use khaali karne ki zimmedari kiski hai.
- **MHM corner.** MHM matlab menstrual hygiene management. Is corner mein spare uniforms rakhi jaati hain, taaki ek daag ki wajah se kisi ladki ko ghar na jaana pade.
- **Periods ko biology ki tarah padhane wale lessons.** Court ne NCERT aur states ki education councils (SCERTs) se gender-responsive curriculum maanga hai, jo ladkon aur ladkiyon dono ki zaroorat samjhe.
- **Ladkon aur male teachers ke liye sessions.** Is par aage baat karenge.
- **Inspections.** Schools ko check karne ki zimmedari District Education Officers (DEOs) ki hai.

Yeh sab kyun zaroori hai? 2019-21 mein India ki kareeb aadhi young women (49.6%) periods mein kapda use karti thi [[nfhs5-india-2021]], aur Indian studies ki 2016 ki ek review mein paaya gaya ki kareeb ek-chauthai teenage ladkiyan (24%) periods ke dinon mein school miss karti thi [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. Is list ki har cheez ghar baithne ki ek wajah kam karti hai.

## Ladke aur male teachers bhi is order ka hissa hain

Faisla kehta hai ki schools ladkon aur male teachers ko bhi periods ke baare mein sensitise karein [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]]. Daag par mazaak, bathroom jaane ki permission na dene wala teacher, mazaak mein class bhar mein ghumaya gaya pad: yahi woh pal hain jo ladki ko ghar baithna sikhate hain.

Chuppi bahut pehle shuru ho jaati hai. Usi 2016 review ke mutabik, India mein kareeb aadhi ladkiyon (48%) ko hi pehle period se pehle iske baare mein bataya gaya tha; yeh figure un 88 studies ko jod kar nikla jinhone yeh sawaal poochha tha [[bmjopen-van-eijk-mhm-india-2016]]. Jab ladkiyan der se seekhti hain aur ladkon ko class se bahar bhej diya jaata hai, toh ladke periods ke baare mein jokes se seekhte hain.

Government aur aided schools mein School Health and Wellness Programme pehle se kehta hai ki do teachers ko, ho sake toh ek male aur ek female ko, "Health and Wellness Ambassadors" ki training di jaaye [[pib-school-health-ambassador-curriculum-2020]]. Ladkon ko kya jaanna chahiye, is par hamari alag Q&A story hai.

## School mein kami ho, toh kiske paas jao

1. **Likh kar rakho.** Date likho, kya missing tha, aur kab se. Photo lo toh sirf khaali dispenser, sookhe nal ya band darwaze ki, kisi student ki kabhi nahi.
2. **School ko likh kar batao.** Principal ko ek chhoti si letter do aur uski copy apne paas rakho. Government ya aided school mein dono Health and Wellness Ambassador teachers ko bhi copy do. Letter mein faisle ka naam likho (Dr Jaya Thakur v. Government of India, 30 January 2026) aur ek fixed date tak jawab maango.
3. **District Education Officer ke paas jao.** Court ne inspection ki zimmedari DEOs ko di hai [[livelaw-sc-jaya-thakur-judgment-2026]], isliye agla step hai district education office ko date wali letter, jiske saath school ko di gayi letter ki copy lagi ho. Private school ke students bhi yeh raasta le sakte hain, kyunki faisla unke schools par bhi laagu hai.
4. **Record maango.** District education office se likh kar poochho ki uski inspection mein tumhare school mein kya mila.
5. **Jaano ki unke upar jawab kaun deta hai.** States ko apni compliance report Supreme Court ko deni hai. 15 October 2026 ko chhapi report ke mutabik, court ne states ko "one last opportunity" diya aur warning di ki jo states jawab nahi denge, unke Chief Secretaries ko contempt notice jaayega; case ki agli sunwai 14 December 2026 ko hai [[livelaw-sc-menstrual-contempt-oct-2026]]. States ne kaise der ki, yeh hamari ek alag investigation mein hai. Tumhare liye iska matlab: date ke saath di gayi complaint aise system mein pahunchti hai jis par Supreme Court ki nazar hai.

Agar periods ki wajah se kisi ladki ki beizzati ki jaaye ya use saza di jaaye, toh parents ya kisi bharosemand teacher ko batao, ya child helpline 1098 par call karo. Tez dard ya bahut heavy bleeding ke liye school koi clinic nahi hai: sarkari health centres, district hospitals aur medical colleges mein Adolescent Friendly Health Centres (AFHCs) counselling aur ilaaj dete hain [[nhm-afhc-page-2026]].

## National policy isme kya jodti hai

December 2024 mein Union government ne court ko bataya tha ki school jaane wali ladkiyon ke liye ek national menstrual hygiene policy haal hi mein bani hai, jise states aur union territories ko laagu karna hai, aur pads zyadatar schools aur anganwadis ke zariye baante jaane hain [[livelaw-sc-menstrual-reserved-2024]].

Isse do baatein nikalti hain. Pehli, ise zameen par utaarna tumhare state ka kaam hai, isliye sirf school nahi, state government ka darwaza bhi khatkhatao. Doosri, agar school jaane wali kisi ladki ko school mein pads nahi mil rahe, toh paas ki anganwadi mein bhi poochho.

Policy aur faisla, dono schools ke baare mein hain. Jo ladkiyan kabhi school nahi gayi, woh periods mein hygienic protection use karne mein sabse peeche rehne walon mein hain [[nfhs5-india-2021]], aur woh is checklist se poori tarah bahar hain; yeh gap isi section ki ek alag story mein hai. Koi haq tabhi asli banta hai jab 13 saal ki ek ladki periods ke dinon mein bhi, bina kisi ki permission ya taras ke, school ka poora din guzaar sake.
